```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_stock_automation_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_product_name TEXT;
  v_warehouse_name TEXT;
  v_should_enqueue BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'active' THEN
    v_should_enqueue := TG_OP = 'INSERT'
      OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'
      OR OLD.severity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.severity;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_should_enqueue THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT p.name_ar INTO v_product_name
  FROM public.products p
  WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;

  SELECT w.name_ar INTO v_warehouse_name
  FROM public.warehouses w
  WHERE w.id = NEW.warehouse_id;

  PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(
    'stock_alert:' || NEW.id::TEXT || ':' || NEW.severity || ':'
      || floor(extract(epoch FROM NEW.last_updated_at))::BIGINT::TEXT,
    CASE
      WHEN NEW.severity = 'out_of_stock' THEN 'out_of_stock'
      ELSE 'low_stock'
    END,
    NEW.id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'stockAlertId', NEW.id,
      'productId', NEW.product_id,
      'productName', COALESCE(v_product_name, 'صنف'),
      'warehouseId', NEW.warehouse_id,
      'warehouseName', COALESCE(v_warehouse_name, 'المستودع'),
      'availableQuantity', NEW.available_quantity,
      'thresholdQuantity', NEW.threshold_quantity,
      'severity', NEW.severity,
      'updatedAt', NEW.last_updated_at
    )
  );

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-162"></a>
## execute_document_correction_once(p_action text, p_record_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_preview_fingerprint text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_document_correction_once(p_action text, p_record_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_preview_fingerprint text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor UUID; k TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_idempotency_key),''); reason TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_reason),'');
  request_hash TEXT; existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; preview JSONB; result JSONB;
  o public.orders%ROWTYPE; cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE; locked_cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;
  shift_id UUID; product_ids UUID[];
BEGIN
  actor:=public.correction207_assert_role_internal(p_action);
  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','3s',true);
  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','30s',true);
  IF p_record_id IS NULL OR reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_REASON_INVALID: اكتب سبباً من3 إلى500 حرف.'; END IF;
  IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;
  IF p_preview_fingerprint IS NULL OR p_preview_fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;
  request_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,'reason',reason,'preview',p_preview_fingerprint)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('document-correction207-key:'||actor::TEXT||':'||k,0));
  SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='document_correction207' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;
  IF FOUND THEN
    IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM request_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;
    RETURN existing.result_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);
  END IF;
  -- Acquire the canonical writer's lock hierarchy BEFORE comparing displayed
  -- facts. Its own relationship validation/locks and all triggers still run.
  IF p_action='pos_sale' THEN
    SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id;shift_id:=o.cash_shift_id;
    IF shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:'||shift_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('pos-sale-reversal:'||p_record_id::TEXT,0));
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=shift_id FOR UPDATE;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT product_id ORDER BY product_id) INTO product_ids FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_record_id);
    IF cardinality(product_ids)>0 THEN PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(product_ids); END IF;
  ELSIF p_action='customer_payment' THEN
    SELECT * INTO cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id;
    IF cp.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|'||cp.order_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=cp.cash_shift_id FOR UPDATE;
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=cp.order_id FOR UPDATE;
    SELECT * INTO locked_cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF locked_cp.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.order_id OR locked_cp.cash_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.cash_shift_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF p_action='supplier_payment' THEN
    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,NULL,p_record_id);
  ELSE
    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,p_record_id,NULL);
  END IF;
  preview:=public.get_document_correction_preview(p_action,p_record_id);
  IF preview->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_STALE: تغير المستند؛ راجع المعاينة الجديدة وأكد مجدداً.'; END IF;
  IF NOT (preview->>'eligible')::BOOLEAN THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_BLOCKED: %',preview->>'blockedReason'; END IF;
  CASE p_action
    WHEN 'pos_sale' THEN result:=public.reverse_pos_sale(p_record_id,reason,k);
    WHEN 'customer_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_record_id,reason);
    WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_supplier_payment(p_record_id,reason,k);
    WHEN 'purchase_receipt' THEN result:=public.cancel_purchase_receipt_v2(p_record_id,reason);
  END CASE;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',207,'action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,
    'idempotent',false,'preview',preview,'writerResult',result);
  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(operation_type,initiated_by,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,result_snapshot,completed_at)
  VALUES('document_correction207',actor,k,request_hash,result,NOW());
  RETURN result;
END; $function$
```

<a id="function-163"></a>
## execute_supplier_replacement_v1(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_supplier_replacement_v1(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_variable
DECLARE
 actor UUID; k TEXT:=btrim(p_idempotency_key); request JSONB; fingerprint TEXT; operation_id UUID:=gen_random_uuid();
 existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; c public.supplier_replacement_cases%ROWTYPE;
 e public.supplier_replacement_events%ROWTYPE; f public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects%ROWTYPE;
 d public.inventory_damage_events%ROWTYPE; p public.products%ROWTYPE;
 reason TEXT; allowed TEXT[]; supplier_id UUID; product_id UUID; warehouse_id UUID; branch_id UUID;
 commercial INTEGER; units INTEGER; qty INTEGER; held BIGINT; written BIGINT; expense BIGINT:=0; stock_delta INTEGER:=0;
 case_id UUID; event_at TIMESTAMPTZ; before_qty INTEGER; cost NUMERIC(24,6);
 case_ids UUID[]:='{}'::UUID[]; return_result JSONB; financial_request JSONB; financial_replay JSONB; return_operation UUID; return_event UUID;
 assignments JSONB; item JSONB; result JSONB; manifest JSONB; order_id UUID; current_values BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 actor:=public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);current_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);
 IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;
 reason:=NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');
 IF reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;
 allowed:=CASE WHEN p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate') THEN ARRAY['supplierId','productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason']
  WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN ARRAY['productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason','reasonCode']
  WHEN p_action IN ('receive','writeoff') THEN ARRAY['caseId','quantity','reason']
  WHEN p_action='reverse' THEN ARRAY['eventId','reason']
  ELSE ARRAY['orderId','items','physicalSources','reason','refundMethod','referenceNumber','notes','supplierAssignments'] END;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) x WHERE NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_FIELD_INVALID'; END IF;
 request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'payload',p_payload||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason));
 IF p_action='customer_return' THEN
  order_id:=(p_payload->>'orderId')::UUID;
  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.phase43_return_physical_sources',public.phase43_canonicalize_return_physical_sources_internal(p_payload->'physicalSources')::TEXT,true);
  financial_request:=public.phase42_canonicalize_return_request_internal(order_id,p_payload->'items',reason,
   p_payload->>'refundMethod',p_payload->>'referenceNumber',p_payload->>'notes');
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';
  END IF;
  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') LOOP
   IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(item))<>3
    OR NULLIF(item->>'supplierId','') IS NULL OR NULLIF(item->>'sourceId','') IS NULL
    OR item->>'sourceKind' NOT IN ('base_order_item','parcel_component','replacement_item') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';
   END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x GROUP BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind',x->>'sourceKind','sourceId',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID,'supplierId',(x->>'supplierId')::UUID) ORDER BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID)
  INTO assignments FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x;
  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'financialRequest',financial_request,'supplierAssignments',assignments);
  -- Exactly the old canonical key/lock/evidence helper, before ANY order or
  -- inventory lock. A previously standalone return cannot acquire a C9 tail.
  financial_replay:=public.phase4_resolve_operation_replay_internal('phase4_return_v1',k,
   public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL),public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(financial_request));
 END IF;
 fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(request::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||k,0));
 SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='supplier_replacement208' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;
  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(existing.id);
  IF p_action='customer_return' AND (financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REPLAY'
   OR financial_replay->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM existing.result_snapshot->>'returnOperationId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;
  SELECT array_agg(x::UUID ORDER BY x::UUID) INTO case_ids FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(existing.result_snapshot->'caseIds') x;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',existing.id,'idempotent',true,
   'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(v,current_values) ORDER BY v),'[]') FROM unnest(case_ids) v));
  IF p_action='customer_return' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('returnResult',existing.result_snapshot->'returnResult'); END IF;
  RETURN result;
 END IF;
 IF p_action='customer_return' AND financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NEW' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'; END IF;
 IF p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate','shop_damage') THEN
  product_id:=(p_payload->>'productId')::UUID;warehouse_id:=(p_payload->>'warehouseId')::UUID;
  supplier_id:=(p_payload->>'supplierId')::UUID;
  IF p_payload->>'unit' IS NULL OR p_payload->>'unit' NOT IN ('base','parcel')
   OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;
  commercial:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;
  -- Warehouse table access precedes inventory locks, matching199 disable.
  SELECT w.branch_id INTO branch_id FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=w.branch_id AND b.is_active WHERE w.id=warehouse_id AND w.is_active;
  IF branch_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_WAREHOUSE_INVALID'; END IF;
  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN
   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[product_id]);
  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN
   -- Canonical receipt cancellation locks inventory BEFORE suppliers. Taking
   -- a blocking supplier FK lock first would invert that hierarchy. Acquire
   -- the parent late without waiting; this also avoids cross-domain customer
   -- financial cycles in the atomic-return path below.
   BEGIN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
   EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY: تغيّر قفل المورد؛ أعد نفس المحاولة.';
   END;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO p FROM public.products WHERE id=product_id AND is_active AND NOT COALESCE(is_flavor_master,false);
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PRODUCT_INVALID'; END IF;
  units:=CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN p.units_per_sale_unit ELSE 1 END;
  IF units IS NULL OR units<1 OR commercial::BIGINT*units>2147483647 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;
  qty:=commercial*units;cost:=COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);
  SELECT on_hand_quantity INTO before_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE inventory_balances.product_id=product_id AND inventory_balances.warehouse_id=warehouse_id;
  IF before_qty IS NULL OR before_qty-COALESCE((SELECT reserved_quantity FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE inventory_balances.product_id=product_id AND inventory_balances.warehouse_id=warehouse_id),0)<qty THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_STOCK_RESERVED'; END IF;
  event_at:=clock_timestamp();
  IF p_action='shop_damage' THEN
   IF p_payload->>'reasonCode' IS NULL OR p_payload->>'reasonCode' NOT IN ('shop_breakage','expired','storage_damage','other') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DAMAGE_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;
   result:=public.adjust_inventory_stock(warehouse_id,product_id,before_qty-qty,
    CASE p_payload->>'reasonCode' WHEN 'shop_breakage' THEN 'انكسر بالمحل' WHEN 'expired' THEN 'انتهت الصلاحية' WHEN 'storage_damage' THEN 'تلف تخزين' ELSE 'أخرى' END||': '||reason,
    CASE WHEN p_payload->>'reasonCode'='expired' THEN 'expired' ELSE 'damage' END);
   SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE movement_id=(result->>'movementId')::UUID;
   event_at:=d.occurred_at;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)
  VALUES(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN 'shop_damage' ELSE 'shop' END,
   CASE WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN d.id END,qty,commercial,units,
   CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN 'طرد' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT name_ar FROM public.units WHERE id=p.unit_id),'باكيت') END,
   COALESCE((SELECT name_ar FROM public.units WHERE id=p.unit_id),'باكيت'),cost,event_at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;
  PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,case_id,CASE p_action WHEN 'shop_pending' THEN 'send' WHEN 'shop_immediate' THEN 'immediate' ELSE 'damage' END,
   qty,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_pending' THEN qty ELSE 0 END,0,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_pending' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END,reason,event_at);
  case_ids:=ARRAY[case_id];
 ELSIF p_action IN ('receive','writeoff','reverse') THEN
  IF p_action='reverse' THEN
   SELECT * INTO e FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID;
   IF NOT FOUND OR e.action='reverse' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVENT_INVALID'; END IF;
   case_id:=e.case_id;
  ELSE case_id:=(p_payload->>'caseId')::UUID; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=case_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_CASE_INVALID'; END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.warehouses WHERE id=c.warehouse_id;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208-case|'||case_id::TEXT,0));
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=case_id FOR SHARE;
  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[c.product_id]);
  -- Verify every product-local C9 inverse pair before excluding its movements.
  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(v.operation_id)
   FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ev.operation_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events ev JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases sc ON sc.id=ev.case_id WHERE sc.product_id=c.product_id) v;
  SELECT COALESCE(sum(held_delta),0) INTO held FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE supplier_replacement_events.case_id=case_id;
  IF p_action='reverse' THEN
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE reverses_event_id=e.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED'; END IF;
   -- No live descendant may be discarded by reversing an earlier event.
   IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT id,action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE previous_event_id=e.id UNION ALL
    SELECT n.id,n.action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events n JOIN descendants x ON n.previous_event_id=x.id)
    SELECT 1 FROM descendants x WHERE x.action<>'reverse' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events r WHERE r.reverses_event_id=x.id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;
   IF held-e.held_delta<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects WHERE supplier_replacement_inventory_effects.event_id=e.id;
   expense:=-e.expense_delta_in_minor_units;
   IF e.action='damage' THEN expense:=-((SELECT loss_in_minor_units FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE id=c.damage_event_id)); END IF;
   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,c.id,'reverse',e.quantity,-e.held_delta,expense,f.on_hand_before-f.on_hand_after,reason,clock_timestamp(),e.id);
  ELSE
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;
   qty:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;
   IF qty>held THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EXCEEDS_PENDING'; END IF;
   IF p_action='writeoff' THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN ev.action='writeoff' THEN ev.quantity WHEN ev.action='reverse' AND original.action='writeoff' THEN -ev.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)
    INTO written FROM public.supplier_replacement_events ev LEFT JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events original ON original.id=ev.reverses_event_id WHERE ev.case_id=c.id;
    expense:=round((written+qty)*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT-round(written*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT;
   ELSE stock_delta:=qty; END IF;
   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,c.id,p_action,qty,-qty,expense,stock_delta,reason,clock_timestamp());
  END IF;
  case_ids:=ARRAY[c.id];
 ELSE
  -- Discover supplier parents without a blocking row lock. The financial
  -- coordinator owns order/shift/inventory acquisition; no earlier supplier
  -- lock may reverse the canonical receipt-cancellation hierarchy.
  FOR supplier_id IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x ORDER BY 1 LOOP
   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.orders o ON o.warehouse_id=w.id WHERE o.id=order_id;
  return_result:=public.settle_admin_sales_return_v1(order_id,k,p_payload->'items',p_payload->'physicalSources',reason,
   p_payload->>'refundMethod',p_payload->>'referenceNumber',p_payload->>'notes');
  FOR supplier_id IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x ORDER BY 1 LOOP
   BEGIN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;
   EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY: تغيّر قفل المورد؛ أعد نفس المحاولة.';
   END;
   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;
  END LOOP;
  SELECT b.id,se.id INTO return_operation,return_event FROM public.business_operations b JOIN public.sales_return_events se ON se.operation_id=b.id
   WHERE b.operation_type='phase4_return_v1' AND b.actor_scope_hash=public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL)
    AND public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(b.idempotency_key)=public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(k);
  IF return_event IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE return_event_id=return_event)<>jsonb_array_length(assignments)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_damage_events de WHERE de.return_event_id=return_event AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x WHERE x->>'sourceKind'=de.source_kind AND (x->>'sourceId')::UUID=de.source_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_MISMATCH';
  END IF;
  -- Canonical return has already discovered AND locked every physical leaf.
  -- It must remain the only stock/financial writer for the customer return.
  FOR d IN SELECT de.* FROM public.inventory_damage_events de WHERE de.return_event_id=return_event ORDER BY de.product_id,de.source_kind,de.source_id LOOP
   SELECT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID INTO supplier_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x WHERE x->>'sourceKind'=d.source_kind AND (x->>'sourceId')::UUID=d.source_id;
   INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)
   VALUES(operation_id,supplier_id,d.product_id,d.warehouse_id,d.branch_id,'customer_return',d.id,d.quantity,d.quantity,1,
    COALESCE((SELECT u.name_ar FROM public.products pr LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=pr.unit_id WHERE pr.id=d.product_id),'باكيت'),
    COALESCE((SELECT u.name_ar FROM public.products pr LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=pr.unit_id WHERE pr.id=d.product_id),'باكيت'),d.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,d.occurred_at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;
   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,case_id,'send',d.quantity,d.quantity,-d.loss_in_minor_units,0,reason,d.occurred_at);
   case_ids:=array_append(case_ids,case_id);
  END LOOP;
 END IF;
 -- Store only the commitment and safe membership IDs in the existing shared
 -- operation envelope. Private costs/effects never escape into that table.
 manifest:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(operation_id);
 result:=jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(manifest::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),
  'caseIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'cases') x),
  'eventIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'events') x));
 IF p_action='customer_return' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('returnOperationId',return_operation,'returnResult',return_result); END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)
 VALUES(operation_id,'supplier_replacement208',k,fingerprint,208,request,actor,result,clock_timestamp());
 PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(operation_id);
 INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details) VALUES(actor,'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT208','business_operations',operation_id,jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'caseIds',case_ids));
 result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',operation_id,'idempotent',false,
  'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(v,current_values) ORDER BY v),'[]') FROM unnest(case_ids) v));
 IF p_action='customer_return' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('returnResult',return_result); END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $function$
```

<a id="function-164"></a>
## expire_stale_new_website_orders(p_batch_size integer)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale_new_website_orders(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order RECORD;
  v_item RECORD;
  v_expired_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_failed_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_attempted_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_candidate_limit INTEGER;
  v_scan_exhausted BOOLEAN := false;
  v_expired_order_ids UUID[] := ARRAY[]::UUID[];
  v_failed_order_ids UUID[] := ARRAY[]::UUID[];
  v_reason CONSTANT TEXT := 'انتهت مهلة حجز طلب الموقع (5 ساعات) قبل قبول الطلب.';
BEGIN
  IF p_batch_size IS NULL OR p_batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'دفعة إنهاء صلاحية الطلبات يجب أن تكون بين 1 و100.';
  END IF;
  -- p_batch_size is a success target.  Candidate attempts are independently
  -- bounded so poison rows cannot consume the success quota or cause a hot loop.
  v_candidate_limit := LEAST(1000, GREATEST(p_batch_size * 10, p_batch_size + 25));
  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('lock_timeout', '3s', true);
  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('statement_timeout', '25s', true);

  FOR v_order IN
    SELECT customer_order.id, customer_order.order_number,
      customer_order.warehouse_id,
      operation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' AS is_v2
    FROM public.orders customer_order
    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations operation
      ON operation.id = customer_order.operation_id
    WHERE customer_order.source = 'website'
      AND customer_order.status = 'new'
      AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at IS NOT NULL
      AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at <= NOW()
      AND customer_order.reservation_released_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY customer_order.reservation_expires_at, customer_order.id
    LIMIT v_candidate_limit
    FOR UPDATE OF customer_order SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    v_attempted_count := v_attempted_count + 1;
    BEGIN
      IF v_order.is_v2 THEN
        PERFORM public.phase3_expire_customer_order_v2_internal(v_order.id);
      ELSE
        IF v_order.warehouse_id IS NULL THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب (%) لا يملك مستودعًا صالحًا لتحرير الحجز.',
            v_order.order_number;
        END IF;
        FOR v_item IN
          SELECT item.product_id, SUM(item.quantity)::INTEGER quantity
          FROM public.order_items item WHERE item.order_id = v_order.id
          GROUP BY item.product_id ORDER BY item.product_id
        LOOP
          UPDATE public.inventory_balances balance
          SET reserved_quantity = balance.reserved_quantity - v_item.quantity,
            updated_at = NOW()
          WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id
            AND balance.product_id = v_item.product_id
            AND balance.reserved_quantity >= v_item.quantity;
          IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
              'تعذر تحرير حجز الطلب (%): رصيد الحجز للصنف (%) غير متطابق.',
              v_order.order_number, v_item.product_id;
          END IF;
        END LOOP;
        UPDATE public.orders SET status = 'expired', expired_at = NOW(),
          expired_reason = v_reason, reservation_released_at = NOW(),
          updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = v_order.id AND source = 'website' AND status = 'new'
          AND reservation_expires_at <= NOW()
          AND reservation_released_at IS NULL;
        IF NOT FOUND THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION
            'تغيرت حالة الطلب (%) أثناء إنهاء الصلاحية؛ تم إلغاء العملية بأمان.',
            v_order.order_number;
        END IF;
        INSERT INTO public.order_status_history(
          order_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, notes
        ) VALUES (v_order.id, 'new', 'expired', NULL, v_reason);
        INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
        VALUES (NULL, 'EXPIRE_STALE_NEW_WEBSITE_ORDER', 'orders', v_order.id,
          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('order_number', v_order.order_number,
            'source', 'website', 'reason', v_reason, 'actor', 'system'));
      END IF;
      v_expired_count := v_expired_count + 1;
      v_expired_order_ids := ARRAY_APPEND(v_expired_order_ids, v_order.id);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      -- A poison row is isolated by this subtransaction. The scheduler can
      -- continue releasing unrelated eligible orders and reports the exact
      -- opaque IDs that require operational review.
      v_failed_count := v_failed_count + 1;
      v_failed_order_ids := ARRAY_APPEND(v_failed_order_ids, v_order.id);
      INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(
        user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details
      ) VALUES (
        NULL,
        'EXPIRE_STALE_WEBSITE_ORDER_FAILED',
        'orders',
        v_order.id,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
          'order_number', v_order.order_number,
          'source', 'website',
          'actor', 'system',
          'sqlstate', SQLSTATE,
          'error', LEFT(SQLERRM, 500)
        )
      );
    END;
    EXIT WHEN v_expired_count >= p_batch_size;
  END LOOP;

  IF v_attempted_count >= v_candidate_limit
    AND v_expired_count < p_batch_size
  THEN
    SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.orders customer_order
      WHERE customer_order.source = 'website'
        AND customer_order.status = 'new'
        AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at IS NOT NULL
        AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at <= NOW()
        AND customer_order.reservation_released_at IS NULL
        AND NOT (customer_order.id = ANY(v_failed_order_ids))
    ) INTO v_scan_exhausted;
  END IF;
  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
    'success', v_failed_count = 0,
    'attempted_count', v_attempted_count,
    'expired_count', v_expired_count,
    'expired_order_ids', v_expired_order_ids,
    'failed_count', v_failed_count,
    'failed_order_ids', v_failed_order_ids,
    'scan_exhausted', v_scan_exhausted
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-165"></a>
## extract_google_maps_coordinates(p_google_maps_url text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `i`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.extract_google_maps_coordinates(p_google_maps_url text)
 RETURNS double precision[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_url TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_google_maps_url), '');
  v_match TEXT[];
  v_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION;
  v_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION;
BEGIN
  IF v_url IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  v_match := REGEXP_MATCH(
    v_url,
    '[?&](?:q|query)=(-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(?:,|%2c)(-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)',
    'i'
  );

  IF v_match IS NULL THEN
    v_match := REGEXP_MATCH(
      v_url,
      '/@(-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?),(-?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(?:,|/|$)',
      'i'
    );
  END IF;

  IF v_match IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  v_latitude := v_match[1]::DOUBLE PRECISION;
  v_longitude := v_match[2]::DOUBLE PRECISION;

  IF v_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90
    OR v_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180
  THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  RETURN ARRAY[v_latitude, v_longitude];
EXCEPTION
  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-166"></a>
## finalize_guest_order_gateway(p_idempotency_key uuid, p_outcome text, p_order_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp","lock_timeout=3s","statement_timeout=5s"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"service_role","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","service_role=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_guest_order_gateway(p_idempotency_key uuid, p_outcome text, p_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
 SET statement_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_request public.guest_order_gateway_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_outcome NOT IN ('succeeded', 'order_rejected', 'gateway_error') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid gateway outcome.';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_request
  FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests
  WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_request.decision <> 'allowed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Gateway authorization was not found.';
  END IF;

  IF v_request.outcome = 'succeeded' THEN
    IF p_outcome <> 'succeeded'
      OR v_request.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_order_id
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Gateway request is already finalized.';
    END IF;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.guest_order_gateway_requests
  SET outcome = p_outcome,
      order_id = CASE WHEN p_outcome = 'succeeded' THEN p_order_id ELSE NULL END,
      finalized_at = NOW()
  WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-167"></a>
## finalize_order_parcel_instance_internal(p_parcel_instance_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_order_parcel_instance_internal(p_parcel_instance_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order_item_id UUID;
  v_locked_order_item_id UUID;
  v_line_kind TEXT;
  v_family_product_id UUID;
  v_configuration_id UUID;
  v_configuration_revision INTEGER;
  v_expected INTEGER;
  v_actual BIGINT;
  v_invalid_components BIGINT;
  v_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
  SELECT instance.order_item_id
  INTO v_order_item_id
  FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
  WHERE instance.id = p_parcel_instance_id;

  IF v_order_item_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = 'P0002',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND: تعذر العثور على الطرد المطلوب.';
  END IF;

  -- Global hierarchy: Order Item -> Parcel Instance -> configuration/products.
  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind
  INTO v_line_kind
  FROM public.order_items item
  WHERE item.id = v_order_item_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instances_order_item_kind_check',
      MESSAGE = 'Parcel finalization requires an explicit configurable Parcel Order Item.';
  END IF;

  SELECT
    instance.order_item_id,
    instance.family_product_id,
    instance.parcel_configuration_id,
    instance.configuration_revision,
    instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot,
    instance.finalized_at
  INTO
    v_locked_order_item_id,
    v_family_product_id,
    v_configuration_id,
    v_configuration_revision,
    v_expected,
    v_finalized_at
  FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
  WHERE instance.id = p_parcel_instance_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_locked_order_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_item_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '40001',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_ORDER_ITEM_CHANGED_DURING_FINALIZATION: أعد المحاولة من معاملة جديدة.';
  END IF;

  IF v_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_ALREADY_FINALIZED: الطرد مكتمل مسبقًا.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration
  WHERE configuration.id = v_configuration_id
    AND configuration.family_product_id = v_family_product_id
    AND configuration.configuration_revision = v_configuration_revision
  FOR SHARE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instance_configuration_snapshot_check',
      MESSAGE = 'Parcel configuration/family/revision is not valid at finalization.';
  END IF;

  -- Stable product ordering prevents two mixed Parcels from taking product
  -- locks in opposite orders. FOR SHARE freezes family membership until commit.
  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.products product
  WHERE product.id = v_family_product_id
    OR product.id IN (
      SELECT component.product_id
      FROM public.order_parcel_components component
      WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = p_parcel_instance_id
    )
  ORDER BY product.id
  FOR SHARE;

  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(component.base_quantity), 0),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE product.id IS NULL
        OR product.is_flavor_master
        OR COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id)
          IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_product_id
    )
  INTO v_actual, v_invalid_components
  FROM public.order_parcel_components component
  LEFT JOIN public.products product ON product.id = component.product_id
  WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = p_parcel_instance_id;

  IF v_actual IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected::BIGINT THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_composition_total_check',
      MESSAGE = FORMAT(
        'Parcel composition total (%s) must equal its pack-size snapshot (%s).',
        v_actual,
        v_expected
      );
  END IF;

  IF v_invalid_components <> 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_component_family_check',
      MESSAGE = 'Every Parcel component must belong to its immutable Family snapshot.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM SET_CONFIG(
    'nawasrah.parcel_finalization_id',
    p_parcel_instance_id::TEXT,
    true
  );

  UPDATE public.order_parcel_instances
  SET finalized_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_parcel_instance_id;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-168"></a>
## finish_go_live_setup_v1(p_confirmation text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_go_live_setup_v1(p_confirmation text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_state public.go_live_setup_state%ROWTYPE;
  v_main_branch UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إنهاء بداية التشغيل');
  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_state FROM public.go_live_setup_state WHERE id FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_state.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', true,
      'finishedAt', v_state.finished_at, 'finishedBy', v_state.finished_by);
  END IF;
  IF BTRIM(COALESCE(p_confirmation, '')) <> 'إنهاء بداية التشغيل' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: اكتب عبارة التأكيد "إنهاء بداية التشغيل" حرفياً.';
  END IF;
  v_main_branch := public.go_live_main_branch_internal();
  IF v_main_branch IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_MAIN_BRANCH_REQUIRED: اختر الفرع الرئيسي الذي تُنسب إليه الديون الافتتاحية قبل الإنهاء.';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.go_live_setup_state
  SET finished_at = NOW(), finished_by = v_user_id, main_branch_id = v_main_branch
  WHERE id RETURNING * INTO v_state;
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SETUP_FINISHED', 'go_live_setup_state', NULL,
    jsonb_build_object('finished_at', v_state.finished_at, 'main_branch_id', v_state.main_branch_id,
      'status', public.go_live_setup_counts_internal()));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', false,
    'finishedAt', v_state.finished_at, 'finishedBy', v_state.finished_by);
END;
$function$
```

## get_active_order_push_targets(p_user_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"service_role","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","service_role=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_active_order_push_targets(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(subscription_id uuid, user_id uuid, endpoint text, p256dh text, auth_key text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT DISTINCT
    subscription.id,
    subscription.user_id,
    subscription.endpoint,
    subscription.p256dh,
    subscription.auth_key
  FROM public.push_subscriptions AS subscription
  JOIN public.profiles AS profile
    ON profile.id = subscription.user_id
  JOIN public.user_roles AS user_role
    ON user_role.user_id = profile.id
  JOIN public.roles AS role
    ON role.id = user_role.role_id
  WHERE subscription.is_active = true
    AND profile.is_active = true
    AND role.code = ANY (ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'orders']::TEXT[])
    AND (p_user_id IS NULL OR subscription.user_id = p_user_id);
$function$
```

<a id="function-170"></a>
## get_admin_ai_inventory_snapshot()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_ai_inventory_snapshot()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_items JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'قراءة مخزون وأسعار مساعد الإدارة الذكي'
  );

  WITH product_stock AS (
    SELECT
      p.name_ar,
      p.sku,
      COALESCE(u.name_ar, 'طرد') AS sale_unit_name,
      GREATEST(p.units_per_sale_unit, 1)::INTEGER AS units_per_sale_unit,
      GREATEST(COALESCE(p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0), 0)::BIGINT
        AS sale_price_in_minor_units,
      COALESCE(SUM(ib.available_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS available_base_units
    FROM public.products p
    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib
      ON ib.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN public.units u
      ON u.id = p.sale_unit_id
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY
      p.id,
      p.name_ar,
      p.sku,
      u.name_ar,
      p.units_per_sale_unit,
      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(
    JSONB_AGG(
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'productName', name_ar,
        'sku', sku,
        'saleUnitName', sale_unit_name,
        'unitsPerSaleUnit', units_per_sale_unit,
        'salePriceInMinorUnits', sale_price_in_minor_units,
        'availableBaseUnits', available_base_units,
        'availableSalePackages', FLOOR(
          available_base_units::NUMERIC / units_per_sale_unit
        )::INTEGER
      )
      ORDER BY name_ar ASC, sku ASC
    ),
    '[]'::JSONB
  )
  INTO v_items
  FROM product_stock;

  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
    'generatedAt', NOW(),
    'items', v_items
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-171"></a>
## get_admin_ai_monthly_report()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_ai_monthly_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_business_date DATE := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;
  v_date_from DATE;
  v_date_to DATE;
  v_report JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'قراءة التقرير الشهري لمساعد الإدارة الذكي'
  );

  v_date_from := date_trunc('month', v_business_date)::DATE;
  v_date_to := (v_date_from + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE;

  WITH branch_reports AS (
    SELECT
      b.id,
      b.name_ar,
      public.get_operational_business_report(
        b.id,
        v_date_from,
        v_date_to
      ) AS report
    FROM public.branches b
    WHERE b.is_active = true
  ),
  totals AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS branch_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'orderCount')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS order_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'grossSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS gross_sales,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'netSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS net_sales,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'grossProfitInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS gross_profit,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'netProfitInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS net_profit,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'collectedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS collected,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'outstandingInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS period_outstanding,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'expenses'->>'count')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS expense_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'expenses'->>'totalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS expenses_total,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'purchases'->>'receiptCount')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS purchase_receipt_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'purchases'->>'totalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS purchases_total,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'balances'->>'customerDueInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS customer_due,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'balances'->>'supplierDueInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS supplier_due,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'inventory'->>'stockedProducts')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS stocked_products,
      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'inventory'->>'lowStockProducts')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT
        AS low_stock_products
    FROM branch_reports
  ),
  branch_payload AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('name', name_ar)
        ORDER BY name_ar ASC
      ),
      '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS payload
    FROM branch_reports
  )
  SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
    'success', true,
    'generatedAt', NOW(),
    'period', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'dateFrom', v_date_from,
      'dateTo', v_date_to,
      'label', TO_CHAR(v_date_from, 'YYYY-MM')
    ),
    'branches', branch_payload.payload,
    'sales', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'orderCount', totals.order_count,
      'grossSalesInMinorUnits', totals.gross_sales,
      'netSalesInMinorUnits', totals.net_sales,
      'grossProfitInMinorUnits', totals.gross_profit,
      'netProfitInMinorUnits', totals.net_profit,
      'collectedInMinorUnits', totals.collected,
      'outstandingInMinorUnits', totals.period_outstanding
    ),
    'expenses', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'count', totals.expense_count,
      'totalInMinorUnits', totals.expenses_total
    ),
    'purchases', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'receiptCount', totals.purchase_receipt_count,
      'totalInMinorUnits', totals.purchases_total
    ),
    'balances', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'customerDueInMinorUnits', totals.customer_due,
      'supplierDueInMinorUnits', totals.supplier_due
    ),
    'inventory', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'stockedProducts', totals.stocked_products,
      'lowStockProducts', totals.low_stock_products
    ),
    'branchCount', totals.branch_count
  )
  INTO v_report
  FROM totals
  CROSS JOIN branch_payload;

  RETURN v_report;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-172"></a>
## get_admin_inventory_product_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_search text, p_branch_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_category_id uuid, p_status text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_inventory_product_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 24, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 24);
  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');
  v_status TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_status), ''), 'all');
  v_offset INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',
      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'
    ],
    'عرض صفحة المخزون الإداري'
  );

  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';
  END IF;
  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';
  END IF;
  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';
  END IF;
  IF v_status NOT IN ('all', 'available', 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'near_expiry', 'damaged', 'stagnant') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر حالة المخزون غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;

  RETURN (
    WITH stock_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        product.id AS product_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity) FILTER (
          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
        ), 0)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,
        COALESCE(SUM(ib.reserved_quantity) FILTER (
          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
        ), 0)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,
        COALESCE(SUM(ib.available_quantity) FILTER (
          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
        ), 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,
        CASE WHEN p_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL THEN p_warehouse_id
          WHEN COUNT(ib.warehouse_id) FILTER (
            WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id
          ) = 1 THEN MIN(ib.warehouse_id::TEXT) FILTER (
            WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id
          )::UUID
        END AS warehouse_id
      FROM public.products product
      LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib ON ib.product_id = product.id
      LEFT JOIN public.warehouses warehouse ON warehouse.id = ib.warehouse_id
      WHERE product.is_flavor_master = false
      GROUP BY product.id
    ),
    inventory_catalog AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        product.*,
        stock.on_hand_quantity,
        stock.reserved_quantity,
        stock.available_quantity,
        stock.warehouse_id,
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.inventory_movements movement
          JOIN public.warehouses movement_warehouse ON movement_warehouse.id = movement.warehouse_id
          WHERE movement.product_id = product.id
            AND movement.movement_type = 'sales_deduction'
            AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR movement.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR movement_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
        ) AS has_sales
      FROM public.products product
      JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = product.id
      WHERE product.is_flavor_master = false
    ),
    filtered_catalog AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT product.*
      FROM inventory_catalog product
      WHERE (p_category_id IS NULL OR product.category_id = p_category_id)
        AND (
          v_search IS NULL
          OR product.name_ar ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR product.sku ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR COALESCE(product.barcode, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        )
        AND (
          v_status = 'all'
          OR (v_status = 'available' AND product.available_quantity > 0)
          OR (v_status = 'low_stock' AND product.available_quantity > 0
              AND product.available_quantity <= product.min_stock_level)
          OR (v_status = 'out_of_stock' AND product.available_quantity <= 0)
          OR (v_status = 'stagnant' AND product.has_sales = false
              AND product.on_hand_quantity > 0)
          -- Product-level expiry/damage state is not stored in the canonical
          -- products table, so these legacy UI filters intentionally match no rows.
          OR (v_status IN ('near_expiry', 'damaged') AND false)
        )
    ),
    paged_catalog AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT product.*
      FROM filtered_catalog product
      ORDER BY product.name_ar, product.id
      OFFSET v_offset
      LIMIT v_page_size
    ),
    detailed_page AS (
      SELECT
        product.id,
        product.sku,
        product.barcode,
        product.name_ar,
        product.description,
        product.category_id,
        product.brand_id,
        product.unit_id,
        product.purchase_unit_id,
        product.units_per_purchase_unit,
        product.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units,
        product.sale_unit_id,
        product.units_per_sale_unit,
        product.parcel_only,
        product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,
        product.cost_price_in_minor_units,
        product.sale_price_in_minor_units,
        product.wholesale_price_in_minor_units,
        product.min_stock_level,
        product.max_stock_level,
        product.is_active,
        product.flavor_master_product_id,
        product.flavor_name_ar,
        product.is_flavor_master,
        product.flavor_sort_order,
        product.created_at,
        product.updated_at,
        jsonb_build_object('id', base_unit.id, 'name_ar', base_unit.name_ar, 'code', base_unit.code) AS base_unit,
        jsonb_build_object('id', purchase_unit.id, 'name_ar', purchase_unit.name_ar, 'code', purchase_unit.code) AS purchase_unit,
        jsonb_build_object('id', sale_unit.id, 'name_ar', sale_unit.name_ar, 'code', sale_unit.code) AS sale_unit,
        product.on_hand_quantity,
        product.reserved_quantity,
        product.available_quantity,
        product.warehouse_id,
        COALESCE(page_stock.warehouse_balances, '[]'::JSONB) AS warehouse_balances,
        product.has_sales,
        COALESCE(movement_count.value, 0)::INTEGER AS movement_count,
        image.image_url
      FROM paged_catalog product
      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id
      LEFT JOIN public.units purchase_unit ON purchase_unit.id = product.purchase_unit_id
      LEFT JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'warehouse_id', balance.warehouse_id,
          'on_hand_quantity', balance.on_hand_quantity,
          'reserved_quantity', balance.reserved_quantity,
          'available_quantity', balance.available_quantity
        ) ORDER BY balance.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_balances
        FROM public.inventory_balances balance
        JOIN public.warehouses balance_warehouse
          ON balance_warehouse.id = balance.warehouse_id
        WHERE balance.product_id = product.id
          AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
          AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR balance_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
      ) page_stock ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS value
        FROM public.inventory_movements movement
        JOIN public.warehouses movement_warehouse ON movement_warehouse.id = movement.warehouse_id
        WHERE movement.product_id = product.id
          AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR movement.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
          AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR movement_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
      ) movement_count ON true
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT pi.image_url
        FROM public.product_images pi
        WHERE pi.product_id = product.id AND pi.is_primary = true
        ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.created_at
        LIMIT 1
      ) image ON true
    ),
    inventory_metrics AS (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_items,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.is_active = true)::INTEGER AS active_items,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.available_quantity > 0)::INTEGER AS available_stock,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
          product.on_hand_quantity::NUMERIC
            * COALESCE(
                product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,
                product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC
              )
        ), 0), 0)::BIGINT AS total_cost_in_minor_units,
        COALESCE(SUM(product.sale_price_in_minor_units * product.on_hand_quantity), 0)::BIGINT
          AS total_retail_in_minor_units,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
          WHERE product.available_quantity > 0
            AND product.available_quantity <= product.min_stock_level
        )::INTEGER AS low_stock,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.available_quantity <= 0)::INTEGER AS out_of_stock,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
          WHERE product.has_sales = false AND product.on_hand_quantity > 0
        )::INTEGER AS stagnant
      FROM inventory_catalog product
    )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'products', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(item) ORDER BY item.name_ar, item.id)
        FROM detailed_page item
      ), '[]'::JSONB),
      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_catalog),
      'metrics', COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(metric) FROM inventory_metrics metric), '{}'::JSONB)
    )
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-173"></a>
## get_admin_parcel_configuration_context_v1()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
