## get_customer_outstanding_orders_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_search text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_outstanding_orders_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);
  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');
  v_offset INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales'],
    'عرض ذمم العملاء'
  );
  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';
  END IF;
  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';
  END IF;
  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';
  END IF;
  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;

  RETURN (
    WITH outstanding_orders AS (
      SELECT customer_order.id, customer_order.order_number,
        customer_order.customer_id, customer_order.customer_name_snapshot,
        customer_order.source, customer_order.payment_method,
        customer_order.total_in_minor_units,
        customer_order.amount_paid_in_minor_units,
        customer_order.payment_status, customer_order.created_at,
        customer.full_name AS customer_name,
        customer.phone AS customer_phone,
        position.outstanding_total_in_minor_units AS amount_due_in_minor_units
      FROM public.orders customer_order
      JOIN public.customers customer
        ON customer.id = customer_order.customer_id
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase42_order_financial_position_internal(
        customer_order.id
      ) position
      WHERE customer_order.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')
        AND position.outstanding_total_in_minor_units > 0
        AND (
          COALESCE(customer_order.source, 'website') <> 'pos'
          OR customer_order.payment_method = 'debt'
        )
        AND (
          v_search IS NULL
          OR customer_order.order_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR COALESCE(
            customer.full_name, customer_order.customer_name_snapshot, ''
          ) ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR COALESCE(customer.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        )
    ), paged_orders AS (
      SELECT * FROM outstanding_orders
      ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
      OFFSET v_offset LIMIT v_page_size
    ), summary AS (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)::INTEGER AS customer_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(amount_due_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT
          AS due_in_minor_units
      FROM outstanding_orders
    )
    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'orders', COALESCE((
        SELECT JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
          'id', id, 'order_number', order_number,
          'customer_id', customer_id,
          'customer_name', COALESCE(
            customer_name, customer_name_snapshot, 'عميل مسجل'
          ),
          'customer_phone', COALESCE(customer_phone, ''),
          'source', source, 'payment_method', payment_method,
          'total_in_minor_units', total_in_minor_units,
          'amount_paid_in_minor_units', amount_paid_in_minor_units,
          'amount_due_in_minor_units', amount_due_in_minor_units,
          'payment_status', payment_status, 'created_at', created_at
        ) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC)
        FROM paged_orders
      ), '[]'::JSONB),
      'total_count', summary.total_count,
      'summary', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'customer_count', summary.customer_count,
        'due_in_minor_units', summary.due_in_minor_units
      )
    ) FROM summary
  );
END;
$function$
```

## get_customer_statement(p_customer_id uuid, p_page integer, p_page_size integer)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_statement(p_customer_id uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_size INTEGER := LEAST(COALESCE(p_page_size, 25), 100);
  v_result JSONB;
  v_evidence_total BIGINT;
  v_canonical BIGINT;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'sales'],
    'عرض كشف حساب العميل'
  );
  IF p_customer_id IS NULL OR v_page < 1 OR v_size < 1 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرّف العميل ورقم الصفحة وحجمها مطلوبون وصالحون.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id = p_customer_id) THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT o.* FROM public.orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id
      AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')
      AND (o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered') OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.pos_sale_reversals r WHERE r.order_id = o.id
          AND (r.actual_effect->>'customer_receivable_in_minor_units')::BIGINT > 0
      ))
  ), vouchers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.* FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN scoped o ON o.id = p.order_id
  ), active_payments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount
    FROM vouchers WHERE NOT is_reversed GROUP BY order_id
  ), completion_history AS (
    SELECT h.order_id, MIN(h.created_at) AS at
    FROM public.order_status_history h JOIN scoped o ON o.id = h.order_id
    WHERE h.new_status = 'completed' GROUP BY h.order_id
  ), completion_operations AS (
    SELECT o.id AS order_id, MIN(b.completed_at) AS at
    FROM scoped o JOIN public.business_operations b
      ON b.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_completion_v1'
      AND b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' = o.id::TEXT
      AND b.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id' = o.id::TEXT
      AND b.completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.id
  ), exposure AS (
    SELECT o.id, o.order_number,
      LEAST(o.total_in_minor_units, GREATEST(
        o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units
          + COALESCE(p.amount, 0), 0))::BIGINT AS amount,
      COALESCE(h.at, c.at, CASE
        WHEN creation.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1'
          AND creation.result_snapshot->>'orderId' = o.id::TEXT
        THEN creation.completed_at END) AS at
    FROM scoped o LEFT JOIN active_payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN completion_history h ON h.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN completion_operations c ON c.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id
  ), movements AS (
    SELECT 'sale:' || id::TEXT AS movement_id, 'sale_debt'::TEXT AS movement_type,
      'دين بيع'::TEXT AS type_label, id AS order_id, order_number AS reference,
      at AS occurred_at, amount AS debit_in_minor_units, 0::BIGINT AS credit_in_minor_units
    FROM exposure WHERE amount > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'payment:' || p.id::TEXT, 'payment', CASE WHEN p.payment_method='cheque' THEN 'تحصيل بشيك مؤجل' ELSE 'دفعة عميل' END, p.order_id,
      p.payment_number, p.created_at, 0, p.amount_in_minor_units
    FROM vouchers p
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'payment_reversal:' || p.id::TEXT, 'payment_reversal', 'عكس دفعة',
      p.order_id, p.payment_number, p.reversed_at, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0
    FROM vouchers p WHERE p.is_reversed
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'return:' || e.id::TEXT, 'return_debt_reduction', 'تخفيض دين بمرتجع',
      e.order_id, o.order_number, e.settled_at, 0, e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units
    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN scoped o ON o.id = e.order_id
    WHERE e.settlement_status = 'settled' AND e.contract_version = 401
      AND e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sale_reversal:' || r.id::TEXT, 'sale_reversal', 'عكس دين بيع',
      r.order_id, o.order_number, r.created_at, 0,
      (r.actual_effect->>'customer_receivable_in_minor_units')::BIGINT
    FROM public.pos_sale_reversals r JOIN scoped o ON o.id = r.order_id
    WHERE (r.actual_effect->>'customer_receivable_in_minor_units')::BIGINT > 0
    UNION ALL
    -- 161: pre-system balance at its original date; a reversal keeps the
    -- original debit and adds its own credit, like a voucher reversal.
    SELECT 'opening:' || b.id::TEXT, 'opening_balance', 'رصيد سابق قبل النظام',
      NULL::UUID, b.entry_number, b.occurred_at, b.amount_in_minor_units, 0
    FROM public.customer_opening_balances b WHERE b.customer_id = p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'opening_reversal:' || b.id::TEXT, 'opening_balance_reversal', 'عكس رصيد سابق',
      NULL::UUID, b.entry_number, b.reversed_at, 0, b.amount_in_minor_units
    FROM public.customer_opening_balances b
    WHERE b.customer_id = p_customer_id AND b.is_reversed
    UNION ALL
    -- 163: the opening part of a unified collection, and its reversal. Order
    -- parts are ordinary customer_payments and appear as payments above.
    SELECT 'opening_collection:' || c.id::TEXT, 'opening_collection', 'تحصيل دين قديم',
      NULL::UUID, c.operation_number, c.created_at, 0, c.opening_amount_in_minor_units
    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c
    WHERE c.customer_id = p_customer_id AND c.opening_amount_in_minor_units > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'opening_collection_reversal:' || c.id::TEXT, 'opening_collection_reversal', 'عكس تحصيل دين قديم',
      NULL::UUID, c.operation_number, c.reversed_at, c.opening_amount_in_minor_units, 0
    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c
    WHERE c.customer_id = p_customer_id AND c.opening_amount_in_minor_units > 0 AND c.is_reversed
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cheque_claim:'||c.id::TEXT,
      CASE WHEN c.claim_kind='returned' THEN 'cheque_return_compensation' ELSE 'cheque_cancellation_compensation' END,
      CASE WHEN c.claim_kind='returned' THEN 'شيك راجع' ELSE 'إلغاء تسجيل شيك' END,
      NULL::UUID,c.reference,c.created_at,c.amount_in_minor_units,0
    FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims c WHERE c.party_kind='customer' AND c.party_id=p_customer_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cheque_claim_collection:'||c.id::TEXT,'cheque_claim_collection','تحصيل قيد شيك',
      NULL::UUID,c.operation_number,c.created_at,0,c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units
    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c WHERE c.customer_id=p_customer_id AND c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units>0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'cheque_claim_collection_reversal:'||c.id::TEXT,'cheque_claim_collection_reversal','عكس تحصيل قيد شيك',
      NULL::UUID,c.operation_number,c.reversed_at,c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units,0
    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c WHERE c.customer_id=p_customer_id AND c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units>0 AND c.is_reversed
  ), running AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT m.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY occurred_at NULLS FIRST, movement_id COLLATE "C") AS sequence,
      SUM(debit_in_minor_units - credit_in_minor_units) OVER (
        ORDER BY occurred_at NULLS FIRST, movement_id COLLATE "C"
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::BIGINT AS balance_in_minor_units
    FROM movements m
  ), page_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM running ORDER BY sequence DESC
    OFFSET (v_page::BIGINT - 1) * v_size LIMIT v_size
  )
  SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
    'customer_id', p_customer_id, 'page', v_page, 'page_size', v_size,
    'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM running),
    'has_more', (v_page::BIGINT * v_size) < (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM running),
    'timezone', 'Asia/Amman',
    'closing_balance_in_minor_units', COALESCE((
      SELECT balance_in_minor_units FROM running ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1), 0),
    'page_opening_balance_in_minor_units', COALESCE((
      SELECT balance_in_minor_units - debit_in_minor_units + credit_in_minor_units
      FROM page_rows ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1), 0),
    'page_closing_balance_in_minor_units', COALESCE((
      SELECT balance_in_minor_units FROM page_rows ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1), 0),
    'movements', COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      'movement_id', movement_id, 'movement_type', movement_type, 'type_label', type_label,
      'order_id', order_id, 'reference', reference, 'occurred_at', occurred_at,
      'original_debt_at',(SELECT c.original_debt_at FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims c WHERE movement_id='cheque_claim:'||c.id::TEXT),
      'reason',(SELECT c.reason FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims c WHERE movement_id='cheque_claim:'||c.id::TEXT),
      'occurred_at_amman', TO_CHAR(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',
        'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US'),
      'date_label', CASE WHEN occurred_at IS NULL THEN 'تاريخ غير متاح' ELSE NULL END,
      'debit_in_minor_units', debit_in_minor_units, 'credit_in_minor_units', credit_in_minor_units,
      'balance_in_minor_units', balance_in_minor_units, 'sequence', sequence
    ) ORDER BY sequence DESC) FROM page_rows), '[]'::JSONB)
  ), COALESCE((SELECT SUM(debit_in_minor_units - credit_in_minor_units) FROM movements), 0)::BIGINT
  INTO v_result, v_evidence_total;

  v_canonical := public.phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal(p_customer_id);
  IF v_evidence_total IS DISTINCT FROM v_canonical THEN
    -- Do not invent an adjustment to make corrupt/incomplete history balance.
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'CUSTOMER_STATEMENT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: أدلة الحركات لا تطابق رصيد العميل؛ يلزم مراجعتها.',
      DETAIL = JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('movements_in_minor_units', v_evidence_total,
        'canonical_in_minor_units', v_canonical)::TEXT;
  END IF;
  RETURN v_result||jsonb_build_object(
    'outstanding_cheques_in_minor_units',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(q.amount_in_minor_units) FROM public.deferred_cheques q
      WHERE q.customer_id=p_customer_id AND q.status IN ('pending','endorsed')),0),
    'has_returned_cheque',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheques q WHERE q.customer_id=p_customer_id AND q.status='returned'));
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-193"></a>
## get_dashboard_analytics()

Owner: `postgres`; security: INVOKER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_analytics()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_today_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW());
  v_yesterday_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');
  v_week_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('week', NOW());
  v_month_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('month', NOW());
  v_30_days_ago TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days');

  -- KPI Variables
  v_today_sales NUMERIC := 0;
  v_yesterday_sales NUMERIC := 0;
  v_week_sales NUMERIC := 0;
  v_month_sales NUMERIC := 0;
  v_total_revenue NUMERIC := 0;
  v_total_cost NUMERIC := 0;
  v_net_profit NUMERIC := 0;
  v_today_orders_count INT := 0;
  v_active_customers_count INT := 0;
  v_total_products_count INT := 0;
  v_low_stock_count INT := 0;
  v_out_of_stock_count INT := 0;

  -- Result Arrays
  v_daily_sales JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_monthly_revenue JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_orders_by_status JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_top_selling_products JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_sales_by_warehouse JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_sales_by_branch JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_latest_orders JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_latest_customers JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_low_stock_alerts JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_recent_inventory_movements JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_today_notifications JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- 1. KPI Calculations

  -- Today Sales & Orders Count (Column in orders is total_in_minor_units)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0, COUNT(*)
  INTO v_today_sales, v_today_orders_count
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE created_at >= v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';

  -- Yesterday Sales
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0
  INTO v_yesterday_sales
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE created_at >= v_yesterday_start AND created_at < v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';

  -- This Week Sales
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0
  INTO v_week_sales
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE created_at >= v_week_start AND status != 'cancelled';

  -- This Month Sales
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0
  INTO v_month_sales
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE created_at >= v_month_start AND status != 'cancelled';

  -- Total Revenue
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0
  INTO v_total_revenue
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE status != 'cancelled';

  -- Net Profit Calculation
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * COALESCE(p.cost_price_in_minor_units, 0)), 0) / 1000.0
  INTO v_total_revenue, v_total_cost
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status != 'cancelled';

  v_net_profit := GREATEST(0, v_total_revenue - v_total_cost);

  -- Counts
  -- Note: customers table does NOT have is_active column; total registered customers are counted
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_customers_count FROM public.customers;
  -- products table DOES have is_active column
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_products_count FROM public.products WHERE is_active = true;

  -- Stock Status Counts (Column in products is min_stock_level, NOT reorder_level)
  WITH prod_stock AS (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.min_stock_level,
      COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS total_available
    FROM public.products p
    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY p.id, p.min_stock_level
  )
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= min_stock_level AND total_available > 0),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= 0)
  INTO v_low_stock_count, v_out_of_stock_count
  FROM prod_stock;


  -- 2. Daily Sales (Last 30 Days)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_daily_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT
      to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,
      to_char(d.day, 'DD/MM') AS "formattedDate",
      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,
      COUNT(o.id) AS "ordersCount"
    FROM generate_series(v_30_days_ago, date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(day)
    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('day', o.created_at) = d.day AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY d.day
    ORDER BY d.day ASC
  ) d;


  -- 3. Monthly Revenue
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(m), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_monthly_revenue
  FROM (
    SELECT
      to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
      to_char(m.month, 'Mon YYYY') AS "monthName",
      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS revenue
    FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '11 months'), date_trunc('month', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 month') AS m(month)
    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('month', o.created_at) = m.month AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY m.month
    ORDER BY m.month ASC
  ) m;


  -- 4. Orders by Status
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_orders_by_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      status,
      COUNT(*) AS count,
      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS "totalAmount"
    FROM public.orders
    GROUP BY status
  ) s;


  -- 5. Top Selling Products
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(tp), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_top_selling_products
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.name_ar AS "nameAr",
      p.sku,
      COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS "totalQuantity",
      COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS "totalRevenue"
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name_ar, p.sku
    ORDER BY "totalRevenue" DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) tp;


  -- 6. Sales by Warehouse
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(w), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_sales_by_warehouse
  FROM (
    SELECT
      wh.id,
      wh.name_ar AS "nameAr",
      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,
      COUNT(o.id) AS "ordersCount",
      CASE
        WHEN v_total_revenue > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 / v_total_revenue) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE 0
      END AS percentage
    FROM public.warehouses wh
    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.warehouse_id = wh.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY wh.id, wh.name_ar
  ) w;


  -- 7. Sales by Branch
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(b), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_sales_by_branch
  FROM (
    SELECT
      br.id,
      br.name_ar AS "nameAr",
      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,
      COUNT(o.id) AS "ordersCount",
      CASE
        WHEN v_total_revenue > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 / v_total_revenue) * 100.0, 1)
        ELSE 0
      END AS percentage
    FROM public.branches br
    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.branch_id = br.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY br.id, br.name_ar
  ) b;


  -- 8. Latest Orders
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(lo), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_latest_orders
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.order_number AS "orderNumber",
      COALESCE(c.full_name, 'زبون مباشر') AS "customerName",
      o.total_in_minor_units / 1000.0 AS "totalAmount",
      o.status,
      o.created_at AS "createdAt"
    FROM public.orders o
    LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) lo;


  -- 9. Latest Customers (Get governorate from customer_addresses table)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(lc), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_latest_customers
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.full_name AS "fullName",
      c.phone,
      COALESCE(ca.governorate, 'عمان') AS governorate,
      c.created_at AS "createdAt"
    FROM public.customers c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT governorate
      FROM public.customer_addresses
      WHERE customer_id = c.id
      ORDER BY is_default DESC, created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) ca ON true
    ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) lc;


  -- 10. Low Stock Alerts (p.min_stock_level instead of reorder_level)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(lsa), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_low_stock_alerts
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.name_ar AS "nameAr",
      p.sku,
      COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS "availableQuantity",
      COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity), 0) AS "onHandQuantity",
      COALESCE(SUM(b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS "reservedQuantity",
      p.min_stock_level AS "reorderLevel",
      (COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) <= 0) AS "isOutOfStock",
      'قطعة' AS unit
    FROM public.products p
    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.is_active = true
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name_ar, p.sku, p.min_stock_level
    HAVING COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) <= p.min_stock_level
    ORDER BY "availableQuantity" ASC
    LIMIT 10
  ) lsa;


  -- 11. Recent Inventory Movements (table is inventory_movements, column is movement_type)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(rim), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_recent_inventory_movements
  FROM (
    SELECT
      m.id,
      COALESCE(p.name_ar, 'منتج غير معروف') AS "productName",
      m.movement_type AS "transactionType",
      m.quantity,
      m.created_at AS "createdAt"
    FROM public.inventory_movements m
    LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = m.product_id
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) rim;


  -- 12. Today Notifications / Audit Logs
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(tn), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_today_notifications
  FROM (
    SELECT
      a.id,
      a.action,
      COALESCE(a.details::text, 'حركة جديدة على النظام') AS details,
      a.created_at AS "createdAt"
    FROM public.audit_logs a
    ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) tn;


  -- Return Combined JSON Payload
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', jsonb_build_object(
      'todaySales', v_today_sales,
      'yesterdaySales', v_yesterday_sales,
      'todaySalesChangePercent', CASE WHEN v_yesterday_sales > 0 THEN ROUND(((v_today_sales - v_yesterday_sales) / v_yesterday_sales) * 100.0, 1) ELSE 0 END,
      'weekSales', v_week_sales,
      'monthSales', v_month_sales,
      'totalRevenue', v_total_revenue,
      'netProfit', v_net_profit,
      'profitMarginPercent', CASE WHEN v_total_revenue > 0 THEN ROUND((v_net_profit / v_total_revenue) * 100.0, 1) ELSE 0 END,
      'todayOrdersCount', v_today_orders_count,
      'activeCustomersCount', v_active_customers_count,
      'totalProductsCount', v_total_products_count,
      'lowStockCount', v_low_stock_count,
      'outOfStockCount', v_out_of_stock_count
    ),
    'dailySales30d', v_daily_sales,
    'monthlyRevenue', v_monthly_revenue,
    'ordersByStatus', v_orders_by_status,
    'topSellingProducts', v_top_selling_products,
    'salesByWarehouse', v_sales_by_warehouse,
    'salesByBranch', v_sales_by_branch,
    'latestOrders', v_latest_orders,
    'latestCustomers', v_latest_customers,
    'lowStockAlerts', v_low_stock_alerts,
    'recentInventoryMovements', v_recent_inventory_movements,
    'todayNotifications', v_today_notifications
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-194"></a>
## get_deferred_cheque_detail(p_cheque_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_deferred_cheque_detail(p_cheque_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result JSONB;v_supplier UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'تفاصيل الشيك');
  v_result:=public.cheque_result_internal(p_cheque_id);
  IF v_result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الشيك غير موجود.';END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(endorsed_supplier_id,supplier_id) INTO v_supplier FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE id=p_cheque_id;
  RETURN v_result||jsonb_build_object('allocations',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY party_kind,original_debt_at NULLS FIRST,id)
      FROM public.deferred_cheque_allocations a WHERE cheque_id=p_cheque_id),'[]'::JSONB),
    'events',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'version',e.version,'kind',e.kind,'at',e.occurred_at,'reason',e.reason,
      'actor',p.full_name) ORDER BY e.version) FROM public.deferred_cheque_events e LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=e.actor_id
      WHERE e.cheque_id=p_cheque_id),'[]'::JSONB),
    'supplierClaims',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.occurred_at NULLS FIRST,c.id)
      FROM public.cheque_supplier_claim_positions_internal(v_supplier)c WHERE c.id IN(SELECT id FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims WHERE cheque_id=p_cheque_id)),'[]'::JSONB),
    'supplierClaimPayments',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'amount_in_minor_units',p.amount_in_minor_units,
      'payment_method',p.payment_method,'paid_at',p.payment_date,'is_reversed',p.is_reversed,'reversal_reason',p.reversal_reason,
      'can_reverse',NOT p.is_reversed AND p.payment_method IN('cash','cliq','bank_transfer')
        AND p.purchase_order_id IS NULL AND p.supplier_receipt_id IS NULL
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheques q WHERE q.supplier_payment_id=p.id)
        AND((p.payment_method IN('cash','cliq') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts s WHERE s.id=p.cash_shift_id AND s.status='open'))
          OR(p.payment_method='bank_transfer' AND p.cash_shift_id IS NULL))) ORDER BY p.payment_date,p.id)
      FROM public.supplier_payments p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_cheque_claim_payments l
        JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims c ON c.id=l.claim_id WHERE l.supplier_payment_id=p.id AND c.cheque_id=p_cheque_id)),'[]'::JSONB));
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_deferred_cheque_home_alerts(p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_today DATE:=(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'تنبيه الشيكات');
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('dueWithinTwoDays',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE due_date BETWEEN v_today AND v_today+2),
    'overdue',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE due_date<v_today),
    'outgoingDueInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE direction='outgoing' AND due_date<=v_today+2),0))
  INTO v_result FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE status='pending' AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id=p_branch_id);
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-196"></a>
## get_deferred_cheques_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_status text, p_direction text, p_branch_id uuid, p_search text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_deferred_cheques_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_direction text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_page INTEGER:=GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page,1),1);v_size INTEGER:=LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size,25),1),100);
  v_today DATE:=(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;v_search TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_search),'');v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'عرض الشيكات');
  IF p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('all','pending','endorsed','cleared','returned','cancelled','due7','overdue')
    OR p_direction IS NULL OR p_direction NOT IN ('all','incoming','outgoing') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر الشيكات غير صالح.';END IF;
  WITH source AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT q.*,c.full_name customer_name,s.company_name supplier_name,e.company_name endorsed_supplier_name
    FROM public.deferred_cheques q LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id=q.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.id=q.supplier_id LEFT JOIN public.suppliers e ON e.id=q.endorsed_supplier_id
    WHERE(p_branch_id IS NULL OR q.branch_id=p_branch_id)
      AND(p_direction='all' OR q.direction=p_direction)
      AND(v_search IS NULL OR q.cheque_number ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%' OR q.tracking_number ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
        OR q.bank_name ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%' OR c.full_name ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
        OR s.company_name ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%' OR e.company_name ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%')
  ),filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM source q WHERE p_status='all' OR p_status=q.status
      OR(p_status='due7' AND q.status IN ('pending','endorsed') AND q.due_date BETWEEN v_today AND v_today+7)
      OR(p_status='overdue' AND q.status IN ('pending','endorsed') AND q.due_date<v_today)
  ),page_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY due_date,id OFFSET (v_page::BIGINT-1)*v_size LIMIT v_size
  ),weeks AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('week',due_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE week_start,direction,
      SUM(amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT amount,COUNT(*) count FROM source WHERE status IN ('pending','endorsed')
    GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('page',v_page,'pageSize',v_size,'today',v_today,
    'totalCount',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered),'hasMore',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered)>v_page::BIGINT*v_size,
    'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)-'registration_txid'-'bank_key' ORDER BY due_date,id) FROM page_rows p),'[]'::JSONB),
    'counts',jsonb_build_object('all',COUNT(*),'pending',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='pending'),
      'endorsed',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='endorsed'),'cleared',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='cleared'),
      'returned',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='returned'),'cancelled',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status='cancelled'),
      'due7',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('pending','endorsed') AND due_date BETWEEN v_today AND v_today+7),
      'overdue',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('pending','endorsed') AND due_date<v_today)),
    'summary',jsonb_build_object('incomingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE direction='incoming' AND status IN ('pending','endorsed')),0),
      'outgoingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE direction='outgoing' AND status='pending'),0),
      'endorsedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE status='endorsed'),0)),
    'weeks',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w) ORDER BY week_start,direction) FROM weeks w),'[]'::JSONB)) INTO v_result FROM source;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-197"></a>
## get_document_correction_preview(p_action text, p_record_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_document_correction_preview(p_action text, p_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  o public.orders%ROWTYPE; cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;
  sp public.supplier_payments%ROWTYPE; pr public.purchase_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  sr public.supplier_receipts%ROWTYPE; po public.purchase_orders%ROWTYPE;
  blocked TEXT; ref TEXT; shift_id UUID; method TEXT; amount BIGINT:=0;
  cash_delta BIGINT:=0; cliq_delta BIGINT:=0; customer_delta BIGINT:=0;
  supplier_delta BIGINT:=0; units BIGINT:=0; payments BIGINT:=0;
  stock JSONB:='[]'::JSONB; effect JSONB; facts JSONB:='{}'::JSONB; result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.correction207_assert_role_internal(p_action);
  IF p_record_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_RECORD_REQUIRED'; END IF;
  IF p_action='pos_sale' THEN
    SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: الفاتورة غير موجودة.'; END IF;
    ref:=o.order_number;shift_id:=o.cash_shift_id;method:=o.payment_method;amount:=o.total_in_minor_units;
    IF o.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'pos' OR o.status<>'completed' THEN blocked:='الفاتورة ليست بيع POS مكتملاً قابلاً للعكس.';
    ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.pos_sale_reversals WHERE order_id=o.id) THEN blocked:='تم عكس البيع مسبقاً.';
    ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_payments WHERE order_id=o.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_returns WHERE order_id=o.id) THEN blocked:='توجد دفعة أو مرتجع مرتبط بالبيع.';
    END IF;
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.product_id,r.order_item_id,r.parcel_component_id),'[]'),
      COALESCE(SUM(r.base_quantity),0) INTO stock,units
    FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(o.id) r;
    IF blocked IS NULL AND units=0 THEN blocked:='لا توجد حقيقة مخزون قابلة للعكس.'; END IF;
    IF blocked IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(o.id) r
      JOIN public.inventory_movements m ON m.product_id=r.product_id AND m.warehouse_id=o.warehouse_id
      WHERE m.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.id AND m.created_at>=o.created_at) THEN blocked:='توجد حركة مخزون لاحقة على أحد أصناف البيع.'; END IF;
    IF blocked IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(o.id) r
      LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id=r.product_id AND b.warehouse_id=o.warehouse_id
      WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.reserved_quantity<>0) THEN blocked:='مخزون أحد الأصناف غير متاح أو محجوز.'; END IF;
    cash_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cash' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END;
    cliq_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cliq' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END;
    customer_delta:=CASE WHEN method='debt' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END;
    facts:=jsonb_build_object('order',to_jsonb(o),'stock',stock);
  ELSIF p_action='customer_payment' THEN
    SELECT * INTO cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: سند القبض غير موجود.'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=cp.order_id;
    ref:=cp.payment_number;shift_id:=cp.cash_shift_id;method:=cp.payment_method;amount:=cp.amount_in_minor_units;
    IF cp.is_reversed THEN blocked:='تم عكس سند القبض مسبقاً.';
    ELSIF o.id IS NULL OR o.status<>'completed' THEN blocked:='لا يمكن عكس الدفعة إلا لطلب مكتمل قائم.';
    ELSIF COALESCE(o.payment_method,'cash_on_delivery')<>'debt' THEN blocked:='لا يمكن عكس قبض لطلب مكتمل غير آجل؛ العكس غير مدعوم.';
    ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments WHERE customer_payment_id=cp.id) THEN blocked:='هذا السند جزء من تحصيل موحد؛ يعكس التحصيل كاملاً من مساره.';
    ELSIF cp.payment_method IN ('cheque','check') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheque_allocations WHERE customer_payment_id=cp.id) THEN blocked:='أصل الشيك ثابت؛ التصحيح من مسار الشيك المعتمد.';
    END IF;
    cash_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cash' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END;
    cliq_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cliq' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END;customer_delta:=amount;
    facts:=jsonb_build_object('payment',to_jsonb(cp),'order',to_jsonb(o));
  ELSIF p_action='supplier_payment' THEN
    SELECT * INTO sp FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE id=p_record_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: دفعة المورد غير موجودة.'; END IF;
    ref:=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(sp.reference_number),''),'دفعة المورد');shift_id:=sp.cash_shift_id;method:=sp.payment_method;amount:=sp.amount_in_minor_units;
    IF sp.is_reversed THEN blocked:='تم عكس دفعة المورد مسبقاً.';
    ELSIF sp.payment_method IN ('cheque','check') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE supplier_payment_id=sp.id) THEN blocked:='أصل الشيك ثابت؛ التصحيح من مسار الشيك المعتمد.';
    ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_cheque_claim_payments WHERE supplier_payment_id=sp.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_opening_payments WHERE supplier_payment_id=sp.id) THEN blocked:='هذه دفعة افتتاحية أو تعويض شيك؛ استخدم مسارها المعتمد.';
    ELSIF (sp.supplier_receipt_id IS NULL)=(sp.purchase_order_id IS NULL) THEN blocked:='الدفعة لا تحمل مرجعاً مالياً واحداً قابلاً للعكس.';
    END IF;
    IF sp.supplier_receipt_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT * INTO sr FROM public.supplier_receipts WHERE id=sp.supplier_receipt_id;
      IF blocked IS NULL AND (sr.id IS NULL OR sr.status<>'completed' OR sr.supplier_id<>sp.supplier_id OR sr.amount_paid_in_minor_units<amount) THEN blocked:='سند المورد أو رصيد دفعاته لم يعد صالحاً للعكس.'; END IF;
    ELSE
      SELECT * INTO po FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=sp.purchase_order_id;
      IF blocked IS NULL AND (po.id IS NULL OR po.supplier_id<>sp.supplier_id OR po.amount_paid_in_minor_units<amount) THEN blocked:='أمر الشراء أو رصيد دفعاته لم يعد صالحاً للعكس.'; END IF;
    END IF;
    cash_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cash' THEN amount ELSE 0 END;
    cliq_delta:=CASE WHEN method='cliq' THEN amount ELSE 0 END;supplier_delta:=amount;
    facts:=jsonb_build_object('payment',to_jsonb(sp),'receipt',to_jsonb(sr),'purchaseOrder',to_jsonb(po));
  ELSE
    SELECT * INTO pr FROM public.purchase_receipts WHERE id=p_record_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_RECORD_NOT_FOUND: سند الاستلام غير موجود.'; END IF;
    SELECT * INTO po FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=pr.purchase_order_id;
    ref:=pr.receipt_number;
    IF pr.phase2_finalized_at IS NULL OR pr.status<>'completed' THEN blocked:='سند الاستلام ليس سند Phase2 مكتملاً قابلاً للإلغاء.';
    ELSIF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE purchase_receipt_id=pr.id AND NOT is_reversed AND operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM pr.operation_id) THEN blocked:='للسند دفعات لاحقة؛ إلغاؤها يحتاج سياسة مستقلة معتمدة.';
    END IF;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units),0),
      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE payment_method='cash'),0),
      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE payment_method='cliq'),0)
    INTO payments,cash_delta,cliq_delta FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE purchase_receipt_id=pr.id AND NOT is_reversed;
    supplier_delta:=-pr.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units+payments;
    SELECT -COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) INTO units FROM public.inventory_movements WHERE operation_id=pr.operation_id AND movement_type='purchase_receipt';
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',s.product_id,'productName',p.name_ar,'baseUnits',-s.received_base_quantity,
      'wacBefore',p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,'wacAfter',CASE WHEN s.opening_global_quantity=0 THEN NULL ELSE s.prior_exact_wac_in_minor_units END)
      ORDER BY s.product_id),'[]') INTO stock FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots s JOIN public.products p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.operation_id=pr.operation_id;
    IF blocked IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots s
      JOIN public.products p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id=s.product_id AND b.warehouse_id=pr.warehouse_id
      WHERE s.operation_id=pr.operation_id AND (p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS DISTINCT FROM s.resulting_exact_wac_in_minor_units
        OR p.cost_price_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM s.resulting_legacy_wac_in_minor_units
        OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(on_hand_quantity),0) FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE product_id=s.product_id) IS DISTINCT FROM s.opening_global_quantity+s.received_base_quantity
        OR COALESCE(b.on_hand_quantity,0)-s.received_base_quantity<COALESCE(b.reserved_quantity,0)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_movements m WHERE m.product_id=s.product_id AND m.mutation_sequence>s.receipt_movement_sequence_max))) THEN blocked:='تحرك المخزون أو تغير WAC بعد السند؛ الإلغاء غير آمن.'; END IF;
    facts:=jsonb_build_object('receipt',to_jsonb(pr),'purchaseOrder',to_jsonb(po),'stock',stock,'payments',
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_payments p WHERE p.purchase_receipt_id=pr.id));
  END IF;
  -- PO cancellation deliberately preserves its existing closed-payment-shift
  -- semantics. Customer legacy NULL shift remains NULL; no fictitious shift.
  IF p_action IN ('pos_sale','supplier_payment') AND shift_id IS NULL AND blocked IS NULL THEN blocked:='المستند غير مرتبط بوردية صريحة.'; END IF;
  IF shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    facts:=facts||jsonb_build_object('shift',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'status',status) FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=shift_id));
    IF blocked IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=shift_id AND status='open') THEN blocked:='لا يمكن العكس على وردية مغلقة.'; END IF;
  END IF;
  effect:=jsonb_build_object('cashInMinorUnits',cash_delta,'cliqInMinorUnits',cliq_delta,
    'customerDebtInMinorUnits',customer_delta,'supplierBalanceInMinorUnits',supplier_delta,
    'inventoryBaseUnits',units,'paymentMethod',method,'paymentInMinorUnits',amount,'stock',stock);
  result:=jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',207,'action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,'reference',ref,
    'eligible',blocked IS NULL,'blockedReason',blocked,'cashShiftId',shift_id,'effect',effect);
  RETURN result||jsonb_build_object('fingerprint',encode(extensions.digest((result||jsonb_build_object('facts',facts))::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'));
END; $function$
```

## get_erp_staff_account_audit_logs(p_limit integer)

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_erp_staff_account_audit_logs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, actor_name text, action text, entity_id uuid, details jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner'],
    'عرض سجل إدارة الموظفين'
  );

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    audit.id,
    COALESCE(actor.full_name, 'النظام'),
    audit.action,
    audit.entity_id,
    audit.details,
    audit.created_at
  FROM public.audit_logs AS audit
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles AS actor ON actor.id = audit.user_id
  WHERE audit.entity_name = 'staff_account'
  ORDER BY audit.created_at DESC
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 50), 1), 100);
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-199"></a>
## get_erp_staff_accounts()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.

Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_erp_staff_accounts()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, full_name text, phone text, job_title text, branch_id uuid, branch_name text, is_active boolean, role_code text, role_name_ar text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner'],
    'إدارة حسابات الموظفين'
  );

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    profile.id,
    profile.full_name,
    profile.phone,
    profile.job_title,
    profile.branch_id,
    branch.name_ar,
    profile.is_active,
    role_row.code,
    role_row.name_ar,
    profile.created_at,
    profile.updated_at
  FROM public.profiles AS profile
  LEFT JOIN public.branches AS branch ON branch.id = profile.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT role.code, role.name_ar
    FROM public.user_roles AS assignment
    JOIN public.roles AS role ON role.id = assignment.role_id
    WHERE assignment.user_id = profile.id
    ORDER BY assignment.created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS role_row ON true
  ORDER BY profile.is_active DESC, profile.full_name ASC;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-200"></a>
## get_expense_shift_center(p_branch_id uuid, p_expense_limit integer)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_expense_shift_center(p_branch_id uuid, p_expense_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result JSONB; v_expenses JSONB; v_recent JSONB;
BEGIN
  v_result := public._get_expense_shift_center_v1(p_branch_id,p_expense_limit);
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.get_cash_shift_display_summary(id) ORDER BY opened_at DESC),'[]'::JSONB) INTO v_recent FROM (SELECT id,opened_at FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE branch_id=p_branch_id AND status IN ('closed','cancelled','reversed') ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 10) r;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(expense_payload ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::JSONB) INTO v_expenses FROM (SELECT oe.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',oe.id,'expenseNumber',oe.expense_number,'branchId',oe.branch_id,'shiftId',oe.shift_id,'category',oe.category,'description',oe.description,'amountInMinorUnits',oe.amount_in_minor_units,'paymentMethod',oe.payment_method,'referenceNumber',oe.reference_number,'isReversed',oe.is_reversed,'reversedAt',oe.reversed_at,'reversalReason',oe.reversal_reason,'reversedByName',COALESCE(rp.full_name,''),'createdByName',COALESCE(cp.full_name,'مستخدم النظام'),'createdAt',oe.created_at) expense_payload FROM public.operational_expenses oe LEFT JOIN public.profiles cp ON cp.id=oe.created_by LEFT JOIN public.profiles rp ON rp.id=oe.reversed_by WHERE oe.branch_id=p_branch_id ORDER BY oe.created_at DESC LIMIT p_expense_limit) e;
  RETURN jsonb_set(jsonb_set(v_result,'{expenses}',v_expenses,true),'{recentShifts}',v_recent,true);
END; $function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_go_live_cheques_v1(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_page INTEGER:=GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page,1),1);v_size INTEGER:=LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size,25),1),100);v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'عرض الشيكات القائمة قبل التشغيل');
  WITH source AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT q.*,c.full_name customer_name,s.company_name supplier_name,e.company_name endorsed_supplier_name
    FROM public.deferred_cheques q LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id=q.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.id=q.supplier_id LEFT JOIN public.suppliers e ON e.id=q.endorsed_supplier_id WHERE q.origin='opening'),
  page_rows AS(SELECT * FROM source ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC OFFSET(v_page::BIGINT-1)*v_size LIMIT v_size)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('page',v_page,'pageSize',v_size,'totalCount',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source),
    'hasMore',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source)>v_page::BIGINT*v_size,
    'entries',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'registration_txid'-'bank_key' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC) FROM page_rows r),'[]'::JSONB),
    'incomingPendingInMinorUnits',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM source WHERE direction='incoming' AND status='pending'),0),
    'outgoingPendingInMinorUnits',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM source WHERE direction='outgoing' AND status='pending'),0),
    'endorsedInMinorUnits',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM source WHERE status='endorsed'),0)) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_go_live_customer_openings_v1(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'عرض ديون العملاء الافتتاحية');
  IF v_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100000 OR v_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة أو حجمها غير صالح.';
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'page', v_page, 'pageSize', v_size,

      FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL)),
    'outstandingTotalInMinorUnits', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(outstanding), 0)
      FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL)),
    'entries', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', b.id, 'entryNumber', b.entry_number, 'customerId', b.customer_id,

      'collectedInMinorUnits', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount_in_minor_units)
        FROM public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a

        WHERE a.opening_balance_id = b.id AND NOT op.is_reversed), 0))
      ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.entry_number DESC)
      FROM (SELECT * FROM public.customer_opening_balances
        ORDER BY created_at DESC, entry_number DESC
        OFFSET (v_page - 1) * v_size LIMIT v_size) b
      JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = b.customer_id), '[]'::JSONB));
```

## get_home_dashboard()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_result JSONB;
  v_balances JSONB;
  v_today DATE := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;
  v_totals JSONB;
  v_profit BIGINT;
BEGIN
  v_result := public._get_home_dashboard_before133();
  v_balances := public.phase133_supplier_balances_internal();
  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{summary}', (v_result->'summary') || jsonb_build_object(
    'supplierPayablesInMinorUnits', v_balances->'supplierDueInMinorUnits',
    'supplierAdvancesInMinorUnits', v_balances->'supplierAdvancesInMinorUnits'));
  IF public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN
    -- Same scope as the month profit above: all branches, Amman month to date.
    v_totals := public.owner_withdrawal_period_totals_internal(
      NULL,
      date_trunc('month', v_today)::DATE::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',
      (v_today + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman');
    -- Unavailable profit stays unavailable: never treated as zero.
    v_profit := CASE WHEN v_result->>'financialFactsStatus' = 'available'
      THEN (v_result #>> '{summary,monthProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT ELSE NULL END;
    v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{summary}', (v_result->'summary') || jsonb_build_object(
      'monthOwnerWithdrawalsInMinorUnits', (v_totals->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,
      'monthRemainingAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits', v_profit - (v_totals->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT));
  END IF;
  IF public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager']) THEN
    v_result:=v_result||jsonb_build_object('chequeAlerts',public.get_deferred_cheque_home_alerts(NULL));
  END IF;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

## get_inventory_movement_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_search text, p_branch_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_inventory_movement_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_product_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);
  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');
  v_offset INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',
      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'
    ],
    'عرض سجل حركات المخزون'
  );

  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';
  END IF;
  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';
  END IF;
  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';
  END IF;

  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;

  RETURN (
    WITH filtered_movements AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        movement.id,
        movement.warehouse_id,
        movement.product_id,
        movement.movement_type,
        movement.quantity,
        movement.balance_before,
        movement.balance_after,
        movement.reference_type,
        movement.reference_id,
        movement.notes,
        movement.created_by,
        movement.created_at,
        COALESCE(product.name_ar, product.sku, 'منتج') AS product_name,
        warehouse.branch_id
      FROM public.inventory_movements movement
      JOIN public.products product ON product.id = movement.product_id
      JOIN public.warehouses warehouse ON warehouse.id = movement.warehouse_id
      WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)
        AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR movement.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)
        AND (p_product_id IS NULL OR movement.product_id = p_product_id)
        AND (
          v_search IS NULL
          OR product.name_ar ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR COALESCE(movement.notes, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR COALESCE(movement.reference_type, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
          OR movement.movement_type ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        )
    ),
    paged_movements AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM filtered_movements
      ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
      OFFSET v_offset
      LIMIT v_page_size
    )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'rows', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(item) ORDER BY item.created_at DESC, item.id DESC)
        FROM paged_movements item
      ), '[]'::JSONB),
      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_movements),
      'product_movement_counts', '{}'::JSONB,
      'sales_product_ids', '[]'::JSONB
    )
  );
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_inventory_opening_setup(p_warehouse_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_payload JSONB;
  v_products JSONB;
BEGIN
  v_payload :=
    public._get_inventory_opening_setup_including_flavor_masters_v1(
      p_warehouse_id
    );

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(item.value ORDER BY item.ordinality), '[]'::JSONB)
  INTO v_products
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(v_payload->'products', '[]'::JSONB))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS item(value, ordinality)
  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = (item.value->>'productId')::UUID
  WHERE p.is_flavor_master = false;

  RETURN jsonb_set(v_payload, '{products}', v_products, true);
END;
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_business_report(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)
```

## get_operational_orders_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_filter text, p_search text, p_sort text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_orders_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_filter text DEFAULT 'action'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);
  v_filter TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_filter), ''), 'action');
  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');
  v_sort TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_sort), ''), 'newest');
  v_offset INTEGER;
  v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner',
      'admin',
      'manager',
      'accountant',
      'cashier',
      'sales',
      'orders',
      'delivery_driver'
    ],
    'عرض قائمة طلبات المتجر'
  );

  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';
  END IF;

  IF v_filter NOT IN (
    'all',
    'action',
    'active',
    'completed',
    'returned',
    'cancelled'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر الطلبات غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  IF v_sort NOT IN ('newest', 'oldest') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ترتيب الطلبات غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';
  END IF;

  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;

  WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id, o.created_at
    FROM public.orders o
    LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'
      AND (
        v_filter = 'all'
        OR (v_filter = 'action' AND o.status = 'new')
        OR (
          v_filter = 'active'
          AND o.status IN (
            'confirmed',
            'preparing',
            'processing',
            'ready',
            'out_for_delivery'
          )
        )
        OR (v_filter = 'completed' AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered'))
        OR (v_filter = 'returned' AND o.status = 'returned')
        OR (v_filter = 'cancelled' AND o.status = 'cancelled')
      )
      AND (
        v_search IS NULL
        OR o.order_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        OR COALESCE(o.customer_name_snapshot, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        OR COALESCE(c.full_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
        OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
      )
  ),
  paged_orders AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM filtered_orders
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,
      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN id END ASC,
      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN created_at END DESC,
      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN id END DESC
    OFFSET v_offset
    LIMIT v_page_size
  ),
  operational_summary AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'new')::INTEGER AS review_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE o.status IN (
          'confirmed',
          'preparing',
          'processing',
          'ready',
          'out_for_delivery'
        )
      )::INTEGER AS active_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(
        GREATEST(
          o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units,
          0
        )
      ) FILTER (WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0)::BIGINT
        AS due_in_minor_units
    FROM public.orders o
    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'order_ids', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM paged_orders),
      '[]'::JSONB
    ),
    'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_orders),
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'review_count', operational_summary.review_count,
      'active_count', operational_summary.active_count,
      'due_in_minor_units', operational_summary.due_in_minor_units
    )
  )
  INTO v_result
  FROM operational_summary;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-211"></a>
## get_or_create_pos_receipt_token(p_order_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_or_create_pos_receipt_token(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_token UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],
    'إنشاء رابط إيصال البيع المباشر'
  );

  SELECT *
  INTO v_order
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE id = p_order_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'pos' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فاتورة البيع المباشر المطلوبة غير موجودة.';
  END IF;

  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('completed', 'returned') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن نشر رابط قبل اكتمال فاتورة البيع.';
  END IF;

  v_token := COALESCE(v_order.public_receipt_token, gen_random_uuid());

  IF v_order.public_receipt_token IS NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.orders
    SET public_receipt_token = v_token,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_order.id;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
      user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details
    ) VALUES (
      auth.uid(),
      'CREATE_PUBLIC_POS_RECEIPT_LINK',
      'orders',
      v_order.id,
      jsonb_build_object('order_number', v_order.order_number)
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'receiptToken', v_token,
    'orderNumber', v_order.order_number
  );
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_owner_warehouses_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'إدارة الفروع والمستودعات');
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'branches',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',b.id,'code',b.code,'name',b.name_ar,'isActive',b.is_active
    ) ORDER BY b.code,b.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.branches b),
    'warehouses',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',w.id,'code',w.code,'name',w.name_ar,'branchId',w.branch_id,
      'isActive',w.is_active,'updatedAt',w.updated_at,
      'hasStockOrReservations',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_balances ib
        WHERE ib.warehouse_id=w.id AND (ib.on_hand_quantity<>0 OR ib.reserved_quantity<>0)),
      'hasMovements',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_movements im WHERE im.warehouse_id=w.id),
      -- Products have no warehouse/default-warehouse column in this schema.
      -- Zero balance rows ARE product assignments; document links count too.
      'hasProductAssociations',(
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_alerts WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_opening_sessions d JOIN public.inventory_opening_items i ON i.session_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders d JOIN public.order_items i ON i.order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_orders d JOIN public.purchase_order_items i ON i.purchase_order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts d JOIN public.purchase_receipt_items i ON i.purchase_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts d JOIN public.supplier_receipt_items i ON i.supplier_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)
      )
    ) ORDER BY w.code,w.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.warehouses w)
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-213"></a>
## get_owner_withdrawals_report(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date, p_page integer, p_page_size integer)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_owner_withdrawals_report(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_from TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_to TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_page INTEGER := GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page, 1), 1);
  v_size INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size, 25), 1), 100);
  v_total INTEGER;
  v_rows JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'عرض سحوبات المالك');
  IF p_date_from IS NULL OR p_date_to IS NULL OR p_date_to < p_date_from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_PERIOD_INVALID: حدد فترة صحيحة.';
  END IF;
  IF p_date_to - p_date_from > 366 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_PERIOD_INVALID: الفترة لا تتجاوز سنة.';
  END IF;
  v_from := p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';
  v_to := (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';

  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_total FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to);
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_json ORDER BY sort_at DESC, sort_number DESC, sort_kind), '[]'::JSONB) INTO v_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'kind', event.event_kind,
      'at', event.event_at,
      'direction', event.direction,
      'amountInMinorUnits', event.amount_in_minor_units,
      'withdrawalId', event.withdrawal_id,
      'withdrawalNumber', event.withdrawal_number,
      'branchId', event.branch_id,
      'branchName', branch.name_ar,
      'shiftId', event.shift_id,
      'shiftNumber', shift.shift_number,
      'actorName', profile.full_name,
      'reason', event.reason,
      'isReversed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals active
        WHERE active.withdrawal_id = event.withdrawal_id AND active.voided_at IS NULL)
    ) AS row_json, event.event_at AS sort_at, event.withdrawal_number AS sort_number, event.event_kind AS sort_kind
    FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to) event
    LEFT JOIN public.branches branch ON branch.id = event.branch_id
    LEFT JOIN public.cash_shifts shift ON shift.id = event.shift_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = event.actor_id
    ORDER BY event.event_at DESC, event.withdrawal_number DESC, event.event_kind
    LIMIT v_size OFFSET (v_page - 1) * v_size
  ) page_rows;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'totals', public.owner_withdrawal_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to),
    'rows', v_rows,
    'totalCount', v_total,
    'page', v_page,
    'pageSize', v_size
  );
END;
$function$
```

## get_pos_configurable_parcel_options_v1(p_warehouse_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pos_configurable_parcel_options_v1(p_warehouse_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_options JSONB; v_state TEXT:=public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','sales'],'قراءة طرود الكاشير');
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.warehouses warehouse JOIN public.branches branch
    ON branch.id=warehouse.branch_id WHERE warehouse.id=p_warehouse_id AND warehouse.is_active AND branch.is_active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023',MESSAGE='PHASE3_POS_LOCATION_INVALID: المستودع غير متاح.';
  END IF;
  IF v_state='OFF' OR (v_state='OWNER_PILOT' AND NOT public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'])) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('featureState',v_state,'options','[]'::JSONB);
  END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('familyProductId',family.id,
    'nameAr',family.name_ar,'parcelConfigurationId',configuration.id,
    'configurationRevision',configuration.configuration_revision,
    'unitsPerParcel',family.units_per_sale_unit,'parcelPriceInMinorUnits',family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,
    'components',components.value) ORDER BY family.name_ar,family.id),'[]'::JSONB) INTO v_options
  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration
  JOIN public.products family ON family.id=configuration.family_product_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',product.id,
    'nameAr',product.name_ar,'flavorNameAr',product.flavor_name_ar,'sku',product.sku,
    'availableQuantity',COALESCE(balance.available_quantity,0)) ORDER BY product.name_ar,product.id) value,
    SUM(COALESCE(balance.available_quantity,0)) available
    FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed
    JOIN public.products product ON product.id=allowed.product_id AND product.is_active
      AND product.flavor_master_product_id=family.id AND NOT product.is_flavor_master
      AND product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NOT NULL
    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances balance ON balance.product_id=product.id AND balance.warehouse_id=p_warehouse_id
    WHERE allowed.configuration_id=configuration.id) components
  WHERE configuration.is_active AND configuration.composition_mode='configurable_mix'
    AND family.is_active AND family.is_flavor_master AND family.units_per_sale_unit>0
    AND family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units>0 AND components.available>=family.units_per_sale_unit;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('featureState',v_state,'options',v_options);
END;
$function$
```

## get_pos_customer_page(p_page integer, p_page_size integer, p_search text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pos_customer_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);
  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);
  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');
  v_offset INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'cashier', 'sales', 'view_only'
    ],
    'البحث في عملاء نقطة البيع'
  );
  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم صفحة العملاء غير صالح.'; END IF;
  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم صفحة العملاء يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.'; END IF;
  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة بحث العميل طويلة جدًا.'; END IF;
  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;

  RETURN (
    WITH filtered_customers AS (
      SELECT c.id, c.full_name, c.phone, c.credit_limit_in_minor_units
      FROM public.customers c
      WHERE c.is_active = true
        AND c.is_blocked = false
        AND c.is_deleted = false
        AND (
          v_search IS NULL
          OR LOWER(c.full_name) LIKE LOWER(v_search) || '%'
          OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') LIKE v_search || '%'
          OR c.id::TEXT = LOWER(v_search)
        )
    ),
    paged_customers AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM filtered_customers
      ORDER BY LOWER(full_name), id
      OFFSET v_offset
      LIMIT v_page_size
    )
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'customers', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', pc.id,
          'full_name', pc.full_name,
          'phone', pc.phone,
          'current_balance_in_minor_units', public.phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal(pc.id),
          'credit_limit_in_minor_units', pc.credit_limit_in_minor_units
        ) ORDER BY LOWER(pc.full_name), pc.id)
        FROM paged_customers pc
      ), '[]'::JSONB),
      'page', v_page,
      'page_size', v_page_size,
      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_customers),
      'has_more', (v_offset + v_page_size) < (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_customers)
    )
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-216"></a>
## get_pos_sale_attempt_state_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_request_fingerprint text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_pos_sale_attempt_state_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_request_fingerprint text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor UUID:=auth.uid(); v_key TEXT:=nullif(btrim(p_idempotency_key),'');
  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; v_cancel public.pos_uncommitted_attempt_cancellations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','sales'],'التحقق من محاولة الكاشير');
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR v_key IS NULL OR length(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200
    OR p_request_fingerprint IS NULL OR p_request_fingerprint !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PACKAGE_D_POS_ATTEMPT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Invalid attempt identity';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_key));
  SELECT * INTO v_operation FROM public.business_operations WHERE idempotency_key=v_key;
  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_operation.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase3_pos_sale_v1'
      OR v_operation.initiated_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable';
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('state','EXISTS','actorId',v_actor,'idempotencyKey',v_key,
      'requestFingerprint',p_request_fingerprint);
  END IF;
  -- A historical order with this raw key is not proof of non-commit either.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE idempotency_key=v_key) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_cancel FROM public.pos_uncommitted_attempt_cancellations
    WHERE actor_id=v_actor AND idempotency_key=v_key;
  IF FOUND AND v_cancel.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM p_request_fingerprint THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Cancellation request identity differs';
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('state',CASE WHEN v_cancel.id IS NULL THEN 'ABSENT' ELSE 'CANCELLED_UNCOMMITTED' END,
    'actorId',v_actor,'idempotencyKey',v_key,'requestFingerprint',p_request_fingerprint,
    'cancellationId',v_cancel.id);
END;
$function$
```

## get_promotion_codes()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
