<a id="function-241"></a>
## go_live_begin_batch_internal(p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_begin_batch_internal(p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');
  v_existing public.go_live_import_batches%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 120 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار للدفعة غير صالح.';
  END IF;
  IF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-batch:' || v_key, 0));
  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.go_live_import_batches WHERE idempotency_key = v_key;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  IF v_existing.batch_kind <> p_kind OR v_existing.request_hash <> md5(p_rows::TEXT) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_KEY_CONFLICT: مفتاح الدفعة استُخدم سابقاً لبيانات مختلفة؛ أعد المعاينة.';
  END IF;
  RETURN v_existing.result || jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay', true);
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-242"></a>
## go_live_cheque_party_internal(p_kind text, p_id text, p_phone text, p_name text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_cheque_party_internal(p_kind text, p_id text, p_phone text, p_name text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id UUID:=NULLIF(btrim(p_id),'')::UUID;v_phone TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_phone),'');
  v_name TEXT:=NULLIF(public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(p_name),'');v_count BIGINT;v_result UUID;
BEGIN
  IF v_id IS NULL AND v_phone IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حدد الطرف الموجود في النظام.';END IF;
  IF p_kind='customer' THEN
    SELECT count(*),min(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count,v_result FROM public.customers
    WHERE NOT is_deleted AND(v_id IS NULL OR id=v_id) AND(v_phone IS NULL OR phone=v_phone)
      AND(v_name IS NULL OR public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(full_name)=v_name);
  ELSIF p_kind='supplier' THEN
    SELECT count(*),min(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count,v_result FROM public.suppliers
    WHERE(v_id IS NULL OR id=v_id) AND(v_phone IS NULL OR phone=v_phone)
      AND(v_name IS NULL OR public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(company_name)=v_name);
  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'نوع الطرف غير صالح.';END IF;
  IF v_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطرف غير موجود أو غير فريد؛ صحح الاسم والهاتف أو اختره من القائمة.';END IF;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-243"></a>
## go_live_cheque_rows_internal(p_rows jsonb)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_cheque_rows_internal(p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_row JSONB;v_plan JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_errors JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_keys JSONB:='{}'::JSONB;
  v_index INTEGER:=0;v_source INTEGER;v_customer UUID;v_supplier UUID;v_endorsed UUID;
  v_direction TEXT;v_status TEXT;v_bank TEXT;v_number TEXT;v_amount BIGINT;
  v_due DATE;v_original DATE;v_cheque_date DATE;v_debt_at TIMESTAMPTZ;v_party RECORD;v_key TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(p_rows) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أدخل من سطر واحد إلى 500 سطر في الدفعة.';
  END IF;
  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) LOOP
    v_index:=v_index+1;v_source:=v_index;
    BEGIN
      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'السطر غير صالح.';END IF;
      IF v_row ? 'sourceRow' THEN
        IF COALESCE(v_row->>'sourceRow','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,6}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم السطر غير صالح.';END IF;
        v_source:=(v_row->>'sourceRow')::INTEGER;
      END IF;
      IF (v_row-ARRAY['sourceRow','direction','initial_status','bank_name','cheque_number','due_date','amount_in_minor_units',
        'customer_id','customer_phone','customer_name','supplier_id','supplier_name','endorsed_supplier_id','endorsed_supplier_name',
        'original_debt_date','cheque_date','notes'])<>'{}'::JSONB THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'السطر يحتوي حقولاً غير معتمدة.';END IF;
      v_direction:=v_row->>'direction';v_status:=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'initial_status'),''),'pending');
      IF v_direction IS NULL OR v_direction NOT IN ('incoming','outgoing') OR v_status NOT IN ('pending','endorsed')
        OR(v_status='endorsed' AND v_direction<>'incoming') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر وارد أو صادر، وقيد الانتظار أو وارد مجيّر فقط.';END IF;
      v_bank:=NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'bank_name'),'');v_number:=NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'cheque_number'),'');
      IF v_bank IS NULL OR char_length(v_bank)>120 OR v_number IS NULL OR char_length(v_number)>80 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'اسم البنك ورقم الشيك مطلوبان ضمن الطول المسموح.';END IF;
      IF COALESCE(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ موجب صحيح بالفلس مطلوب.';END IF;
      v_amount:=(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
      IF COALESCE(v_row->>'due_date','') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الاستحقاق مطلوب بصيغة سنة-شهر-يوم.';END IF;
      v_due:=(v_row->>'due_date')::DATE;v_original:=NULL;v_cheque_date:=NULL;
      IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'original_debt_date'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF(v_row->>'original_debt_date') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الدين الأصلي غير صالح.';END IF;
        v_original:=(v_row->>'original_debt_date')::DATE;
      END IF;
      IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'cheque_date'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF(v_row->>'cheque_date') !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الشيك غير صالح.';END IF;
        v_cheque_date:=(v_row->>'cheque_date')::DATE;
      END IF;
      v_debt_at:=COALESCE(v_original,v_cheque_date)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';
      IF char_length(COALESCE(v_row->>'notes',''))>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الملاحظة لا تتجاوز 500 حرف.';END IF;
      v_customer:=NULL;v_supplier:=NULL;v_endorsed:=NULL;
      IF v_direction='incoming' THEN
        IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوارد يرتبط بالزبون؛ استخدم حقل المورد المجيّر له عند الحاجة.';END IF;
        v_customer:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('customer',v_row->>'customer_id',v_row->>'customer_phone',v_row->>'customer_name');
        IF v_status='endorsed' THEN
          v_endorsed:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('supplier',v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id',NULL,v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name');
        ELSIF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر حالة مجيّر عند تحديد مورد التجيير.';
        END IF;
      ELSE
        IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_phone'),'') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_name'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL
          OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الصادر يرتبط بمورد واحد فقط.';END IF;
        v_supplier:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('supplier',v_row->>'supplier_id',NULL,v_row->>'supplier_name');
      END IF;
      FOR v_party IN SELECT 'customer'::TEXT kind,v_customer id WHERE v_customer IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier',COALESCE(v_supplier,v_endorsed) WHERE COALESCE(v_supplier,v_endorsed) IS NOT NULL LOOP
        v_key:=v_party.kind||':'||v_party.id::TEXT||':'||lower(v_bank)||':'||v_number;
        IF v_keys ? v_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cheque_party_keys k WHERE k.party_kind=v_party.kind
          AND k.party_id=v_party.id AND k.bank_key=lower(v_bank) AND k.cheque_number=v_number) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الشيك مكرر للطرف والبنك والرقم؛ يشمل ذلك الشيكات المسجلة سابقاً.';END IF;
        v_keys:=v_keys||jsonb_build_object(v_key,true);
      END LOOP;
      v_plan:=v_plan||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('sourceRow',v_source,'direction',v_direction,'status',v_status,
        'bank',v_bank,'number',v_number,'dueDate',v_due,'amount',v_amount,'customerId',v_customer,'supplierId',v_supplier,
        'endorsedSupplierId',v_endorsed,'originalDebtAt',v_debt_at,'originalDebtDate',v_original,'chequeDate',v_cheque_date,
        'notes',NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'notes'),'')));
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      v_errors:=v_errors||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('row',v_source,'message',
        CASE WHEN SQLSTATE IN ('22007','22008') THEN 'تاريخ غير صالح؛ استخدم سنة-شهر-يوم.'
          WHEN SQLSTATE='22P02' THEN 'معرف الطرف غير صالح.' ELSE SQLERRM END));
    END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('rows',v_plan,'errors',v_errors,'rowCount',jsonb_array_length(p_rows),'validCount',jsonb_array_length(v_plan));
END;
$function$
```

## go_live_collection_result_internal(p_operation_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_collection_result_internal(p_operation_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('success',true,'operationId',op.id,'operationNumber',op.operation_number,
    'customerId',op.customer_id,'amountInMinorUnits',op.amount_in_minor_units,
    'openingAmountInMinorUnits',op.opening_amount_in_minor_units,'ordersAmountInMinorUnits',op.orders_amount_in_minor_units,
    'compensationAmountInMinorUnits',op.compensation_amount_in_minor_units,'paymentMethod',op.payment_method,
    'isReversed',op.is_reversed,'createdAt',op.created_at,
    'chequeId',(SELECT q.id FROM public.deferred_cheques q WHERE q.collection_operation_id=op.id),
    'parts',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(part ORDER BY sort_key) FROM(
      SELECT b.occurred_at::TEXT||b.entry_number sort_key,jsonb_build_object('kind','opening','id',b.id,'reference',b.entry_number,
        'amountInMinorUnits',a.amount_in_minor_units)part FROM public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a
        JOIN public.customer_opening_balances b ON b.id=a.opening_balance_id WHERE a.operation_id=op.id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT '~'||o.created_at::TEXT||o.order_number,jsonb_build_object('kind','order','id',o.id,'reference',o.order_number,
        'paymentId',l.customer_payment_id,'amountInMinorUnits',l.amount_in_minor_units)
      FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments l JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=l.order_id WHERE l.operation_id=op.id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT COALESCE(c.original_debt_at::TEXT,'')||c.reference,jsonb_build_object('kind','compensation','id',c.id,
        'reference',c.reference,'claimKind',c.claim_kind,'amountInMinorUnits',a.amount_in_minor_units)
      FROM public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims c ON c.id=a.claim_id
      WHERE a.operation_id=op.id
    )parts),'[]'::JSONB),'remainingBalanceInMinorUnits',public.phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal(op.customer_id))
  FROM public.customer_collection_operations op WHERE op.id=p_operation_id;
$function$
```

<a id="function-245"></a>
## go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(p_customer_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.

Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, customer_id uuid, entry_number text, principal bigint, outstanding bigint, occurred_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT b.id, b.customer_id, b.entry_number, b.amount_in_minor_units,
    (b.amount_in_minor_units - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount_in_minor_units)
      FROM public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a
      JOIN public.customer_collection_operations op ON op.id = a.operation_id
      WHERE a.opening_balance_id = b.id AND NOT op.is_reversed), 0))::BIGINT,
    b.occurred_at
  FROM public.customer_opening_balances b
  WHERE NOT b.is_reversed AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR b.customer_id = p_customer_id);
$function$
```

<a id="function-246"></a>
## go_live_guard_collection_operation()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_guard_collection_operation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.is_reversed OR NOT NEW.is_reversed
    OR(NEW.id,NEW.operation_number,NEW.customer_id,NEW.amount_in_minor_units,
      NEW.opening_amount_in_minor_units,NEW.orders_amount_in_minor_units,NEW.compensation_amount_in_minor_units,
      NEW.payment_method,NEW.reference_number,NEW.notes,NEW.branch_id,NEW.cash_shift_id,NEW.idempotency_key,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM(OLD.id,OLD.operation_number,OLD.customer_id,OLD.amount_in_minor_units,
      OLD.opening_amount_in_minor_units,OLD.orders_amount_in_minor_units,OLD.compensation_amount_in_minor_units,
      OLD.payment_method,OLD.reference_number,OLD.notes,OLD.branch_id,OLD.cash_shift_id,OLD.idempotency_key,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_COLLECTION_IMMUTABLE: سجل التحصيل دائم؛ التصحيح بعكس العملية كاملة فقط.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE collection_operation_id=OLD.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_ORIGINAL_PAYMENT_IMMUTABLE: أصل تحصيل الشيك ثابت؛ استخدم انتقال الشيك المعتمد.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_guard_collection_payment_reversal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_operation_id UUID;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.is_reversed AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.is_reversed, false) THEN
    SELECT operation_id INTO v_operation_id
    FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments WHERE customer_payment_id = NEW.id;
    IF v_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(current_setting('nawasrah.collection_reversal', true), '') <> v_operation_id::TEXT THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_COLLECTION_PART_REVERSAL: هذا السند جزء من عملية تحصيل موحدة؛ اعكس العملية كاملة.';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-254"></a>
## go_live_plan_customer_collection_internal(p_customer_id uuid, p_amount bigint)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_plan_customer_collection_internal(p_customer_id uuid, p_amount bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH debts AS (
    SELECT 1 kind_order,'opening'::TEXT kind,o.id,o.entry_number reference,o.occurred_at debt_at,
      o.occurred_at original_debt_at,o.outstanding
    FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(p_customer_id)o WHERE o.outstanding>0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2,'order',o.id,o.order_number,o.created_at,public.cheque_order_debt_date_internal(o.id),p.outstanding_total_in_minor_units
    FROM public.orders o CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase42_order_financial_position_internal(o.id)p
    WHERE o.customer_id=p_customer_id AND o.status IN ('completed','delivered')
      AND(COALESCE(o.source,'website')<>'pos' OR o.payment_method='debt') AND p.outstanding_total_in_minor_units>0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT public.cheque_customer_claim_lane_internal(c.id),
      'compensation',c.id,c.reference,c.occurred_at,c.occurred_at,c.outstanding
    FROM public.cheque_customer_claim_positions_internal(p_customer_id)c WHERE c.outstanding>0
  ),ordered AS (
    SELECT d.*,COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) OVER(ORDER BY kind_order,debt_at NULLS FIRST,reference,id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) before_amount FROM debts d
  ),allocated AS (
    SELECT o.*,GREATEST(LEAST(o.outstanding,COALESCE(p_amount,0)-o.before_amount),0)::BIGINT allocate FROM ordered o
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'openingOutstandingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) FILTER(WHERE kind='opening'),0),
    'ordersOutstandingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) FILTER(WHERE kind='order'),0),
    'compensationOutstandingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) FILTER(WHERE kind='compensation'),0),
    'totalOutstandingInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(outstanding),0),
    'openingAllocatedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(allocate) FILTER(WHERE kind='opening'),0),
    'ordersAllocatedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(allocate) FILTER(WHERE kind='order'),0),
    'compensationAllocatedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(allocate) FILTER(WHERE kind='compensation'),0),
    'parts',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'id',id,'reference',reference,
      'debtAt',debt_at,'originalDebtAt',original_debt_at,'outstandingInMinorUnits',outstanding,
      'allocateInMinorUnits',allocate,'remainingAfterInMinorUnits',outstanding-allocate)
      ORDER BY kind_order,debt_at NULLS FIRST,reference,id),'[]'::JSONB)) FROM allocated;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_setup_counts_internal()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'products', jsonb_build_object(
      'activeCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.products WHERE is_active AND NOT is_flavor_master),
      'importedCount', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(row_count), 0) FROM public.go_live_import_batches
        WHERE batch_kind = 'products')),
    'stock', jsonb_build_object(
      'stockableCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.products WHERE is_active AND NOT is_flavor_master),
      'countedProductCount', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM public.inventory_opening_items),
      'sessionCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.inventory_opening_sessions)),
    'customers', jsonb_build_object(
      'customerCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.customers WHERE NOT is_deleted),
      'withOpeningCount', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM public.customer_opening_balances
        WHERE NOT is_reversed),
      'activeEntryCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.customer_opening_balances WHERE NOT is_reversed),
      'activeTotalInMinorUnits', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)
        FROM public.customer_opening_balances WHERE NOT is_reversed)),
    'suppliers', jsonb_build_object(
      'supplierCount', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.suppliers WHERE is_active),
      'withOpeningCount', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id) FROM public.supplier_opening_balances
        WHERE NOT is_reversed),
      'payableTotalInMinorUnits', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)
        FROM public.supplier_opening_balances WHERE NOT is_reversed AND direction = 'payable'),
      'advanceTotalInMinorUnits', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)
        FROM public.supplier_opening_balances WHERE NOT is_reversed AND direction = 'advance'))
  );
$function$
```

<a id="function-262"></a>
## go_live_supplier_opening_payable_internal(p_supplier_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_supplier_opening_payable_internal(p_supplier_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT GREATEST(LEAST(
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM public.supplier_opening_balances
      WHERE supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND direction='payable' AND NOT is_reversed),0)
    -COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_in_minor_units) FROM public.supplier_opening_payments l
      JOIN public.supplier_payments p ON p.id=l.supplier_payment_id
      WHERE l.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_reversed,false)),0)
    -COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount_in_minor_units) FROM public.deferred_cheque_allocations a
      JOIN public.deferred_cheques c ON c.id=a.cheque_id
      JOIN public.supplier_payments p ON p.id=c.supplier_payment_id
      WHERE a.party_kind='supplier' AND a.party_id=p_supplier_id AND a.origin_kind='opening'
        AND p.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND NOT p.is_reversed
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_opening_payments l WHERE l.supplier_payment_id=p.id)),0),
    COALESCE((SELECT current_balance_in_minor_units FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id),0)
  ),0)::BIGINT;
$function$
```

<a id="function-263"></a>
## guard_cash_shift_closing_report_snapshot()

Owner: `postgres`; security: INVOKER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"PUBLIC","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `null`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_cash_shift_closing_report_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- A captured report is an audit artifact: it can never be overwritten,
  -- cleared, or version-swapped after it has been stored.
  IF OLD.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      NEW.closing_report_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot
      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshotted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshotted_at
      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshot_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot_version
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لقطة تقرير الإغلاق محفوظة ولا يمكن تعديلها أو حذفها.';
  END IF;

  -- Historical closed shifts deliberately remain without a fabricated
  -- snapshot. The one permitted late write is the second update performed by
  -- close_cash_shift in the same transaction that changed open -> closed.
  IF OLD.closing_report_snapshot IS NULL
    AND NEW.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT (
      NEW.status = 'closed'
      AND (
        OLD.status = 'open'
        OR (
          OLD.status = 'closed'
          AND OLD.closed_at = transaction_timestamp()
        )
      )
    )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إضافة لقطة تقرير إلى وردية تاريخية مغلقة.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

## guard_finalized_order_parcel_item_history()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.

Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_finalized_order_parcel_item_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cost_transition BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    v_cost_transition :=
      OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
      AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(
        OLD.order_id, 'order_item', OLD.id
      )
      AND ROW(
        NEW.order_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.product_name_snapshot, NEW.sku_snapshot,
        NEW.quantity, NEW.unit_price_in_minor_units, NEW.line_total_in_minor_units,
        NEW.sale_package_quantity, NEW.units_per_sale_package,
        NEW.sale_package_name_snapshot, NEW.sale_package_price_in_minor_units,
        NEW.commercial_line_kind, NEW.family_product_id,
        NEW.parcel_configuration_id, NEW.parcel_configuration_revision,
        NEW.base_unit_name_snapshot,
        NEW.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
        NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, NEW.created_at
      ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
        OLD.order_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.product_name_snapshot, OLD.sku_snapshot,
        OLD.quantity, OLD.unit_price_in_minor_units, OLD.line_total_in_minor_units,
        OLD.sale_package_quantity, OLD.units_per_sale_package,
        OLD.sale_package_name_snapshot, OLD.sale_package_price_in_minor_units,
        OLD.commercial_line_kind, OLD.family_product_id,
        OLD.parcel_configuration_id, OLD.parcel_configuration_revision,
        OLD.base_unit_name_snapshot,
        OLD.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
        OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, OLD.created_at
      );
    IF v_cost_transition THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
  WHERE instance.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY instance.id FOR UPDATE;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_LINE_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد بدء إنشاء طرد مرتبط به.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation
  WHERE reservation.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY reservation.id FOR UPDATE;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'RESERVED_ORDER_ITEM_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد إنشاء حجز مرتبط به.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_return_items return_item
  WHERE return_item.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY return_item.id FOR UPDATE;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_return_items WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'RETURNED_ORDER_ITEM_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد إنشاء إرجاع مرتبط به.';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_new_configurable_parcel_row()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_new_kind TEXT;
  v_old_kind TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'order_parcel_instances' THEN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
      PERFORM public.assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed();
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_new_kind := TO_JSONB(NEW)->>'commercial_line_kind';

  IF v_new_kind = 'configurable_parcel'
    AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR v_old_kind IS DISTINCT FROM v_new_kind)
  THEN
    PERFORM public.assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed();
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_inventory_reservation_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'RESERVATION_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف سجل الحجز التاريخي.';
  END IF;

  IF ROW(
    NEW.operation_id,
    NEW.order_id,

    NEW.warehouse_id,
    NEW.product_id,

      MESSAGE = 'RESERVATION_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل هوية أو كمية الحجز الأصلية.';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.reservation_state <> 'active'
    AND ROW(NEW.reservation_state, NEW.resolved_at)

  THEN
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_parcel_component_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order_id UUID;
  v_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_cost_transition BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    SELECT instance.order_id, instance.finalized_at
    INTO v_order_id, v_finalized_at
    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
    WHERE instance.id = OLD.parcel_instance_id
    FOR UPDATE;
  ELSE
    SELECT instance.order_id, instance.finalized_at
    INTO v_order_id, v_finalized_at
    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
    WHERE instance.id = NEW.parcel_instance_id
    FOR UPDATE;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF v_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'FINALIZED_PARCEL_COMPONENT_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف مكونات طرد مكتمل.';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    v_cost_transition :=
      OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
      AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(
        v_order_id, 'parcel_component', OLD.id
      )
      AND ROW(
        NEW.parcel_instance_id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.product_id,
        NEW.base_quantity, NEW.product_name_snapshot, NEW.sku_snapshot,
        NEW.base_unit_name_snapshot,
        NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units,
        NEW.created_at
      ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
        OLD.parcel_instance_id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.product_id,
        OLD.base_quantity, OLD.product_name_snapshot, OLD.sku_snapshot,
        OLD.base_unit_name_snapshot,
        OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units,
        OLD.created_at
      );
    IF v_cost_transition THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'FINALIZED_PARCEL_COMPONENT_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل مكونات طرد مكتمل.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_parcel_instance_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cost_transition BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    IF OLD.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'FINALIZED_PARCEL_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف حقيقة طرد مكتمل.';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  v_cost_transition :=
    OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    AND public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(
      OLD.order_id, 'parcel_instance', OLD.id
    )
    AND ROW(
      NEW.order_item_id, NEW.order_id, NEW.operation_id,
      NEW.parcel_configuration_id, NEW.family_product_id,
      NEW.instance_sequence, NEW.configuration_revision,
      NEW.units_per_parcel_snapshot, NEW.parcel_unit_name_snapshot,
      NEW.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      NEW.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      NEW.composition_fingerprint, NEW.finalized_at, NEW.created_at
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.order_item_id, OLD.order_id, OLD.operation_id,
      OLD.parcel_configuration_id, OLD.family_product_id,
      OLD.instance_sequence, OLD.configuration_revision,
      OLD.units_per_parcel_snapshot, OLD.parcel_unit_name_snapshot,
      OLD.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      OLD.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
      OLD.composition_fingerprint, OLD.finalized_at, OLD.created_at
    );

  IF v_cost_transition THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'FINALIZED_PARCEL_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل حقيقة طرد مكتمل.';
  END IF;

  IF ROW(
    NEW.order_item_id, NEW.order_id, NEW.operation_id,
    NEW.parcel_configuration_id, NEW.family_product_id,
    NEW.instance_sequence, NEW.configuration_revision,
    NEW.units_per_parcel_snapshot, NEW.parcel_unit_name_snapshot,
    NEW.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    NEW.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    NEW.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units, NEW.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    NEW.cost_finalized_at, NEW.composition_fingerprint, NEW.created_at
  ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
    OLD.order_item_id, OLD.order_id, OLD.operation_id,
    OLD.parcel_configuration_id, OLD.family_product_id,
    OLD.instance_sequence, OLD.configuration_revision,
    OLD.units_per_parcel_snapshot, OLD.parcel_unit_name_snapshot,
    OLD.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    OLD.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    OLD.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units, OLD.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,
    OLD.cost_finalized_at, OLD.composition_fingerprint, OLD.created_at
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن إعادة ربط أو تعديل حقيقة الطرد بعد إنشائه.';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.finalized_at IS NULL AND NEW.finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.parcel_finalization_id', true)
      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id::TEXT
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_FINALIZATION_REQUIRES_INTERNAL_PROTOCOL: استخدم مسار الإكمال الذري المحمي.';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.finalized_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.finalized_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_FINALIZATION_INVALID_TRANSITION: حد الإكمال أحادي الاتجاه.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_paid_order_customer_payment_reversal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_status TEXT;
  v_payment_method TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.is_reversed AND NOT OLD.is_reversed AND OLD.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT status, payment_method INTO v_status, v_payment_method
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE id = OLD.order_id;
    IF v_status = 'completed'
      AND COALESCE(v_payment_method, 'cash_on_delivery') <> 'debt'
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING
        ERRCODE = 'P0001',

    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-272"></a>
## guard_phase2_receipt_header_history()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase2_receipt_header_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_old_core JSONB;
  v_new_core JSONB;
BEGIN
  IF OLD.phase2_finalized_at IS NULL THEN RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف سند Phase 2 النهائي.';
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'supplier_receipts' THEN
    v_old_core := to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY[
      'status', 'is_archived', 'amount_paid_in_minor_units',
      'amount_due_in_minor_units', 'payment_status', 'updated_at',
      'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',
      'phase2_cancellation_reason'
    ];
    v_new_core := to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY[
      'status', 'is_archived', 'amount_paid_in_minor_units',
      'amount_due_in_minor_units', 'payment_status', 'updated_at',
      'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',
      'phase2_cancellation_reason'
    ];
  ELSE
    v_old_core := to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY[
      'status', 'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',
      'phase2_cancellation_reason'
    ];
    v_new_core := to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY[
      'status', 'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',
      'phase2_cancellation_reason'
    ];
  END IF;
  IF v_old_core IS DISTINCT FROM v_new_core THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل الحقيقة المالية التاريخية للسند.';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_CANCELLATION_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن إعادة تفعيل سند ملغى.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

## guard_phase3_customer_order_cost_finalization()

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase3_customer_order_cost_finalization()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.cost_finalized_at THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_guards guard_authorization
      WHERE guard_authorization.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()
        AND guard_authorization.order_id = OLD.id
        AND guard_authorization.row_kind = 'order'
        AND guard_authorization.row_id = OLD.id
        AND guard_authorization.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(
          'nawasrah.customer_cost_finalization_operation_id', true
        )
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
    MESSAGE = 'CUSTOMER_ORDER_COST_FINALIZATION_IMMUTABLE: حد تكلفة الطلب أحادي الاتجاه ومحمي.';
END;
```

<a id="function-274"></a>
## guard_phase3_customer_v2_terminal_status()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase3_customer_v2_terminal_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_operation_type TEXT;
  v_expected_reservation_state TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status
    OR NEW.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'expired')
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT operation.operation_type INTO v_operation_type
  FROM public.business_operations operation
  WHERE operation.id = OLD.operation_id;

  IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards lifecycle_guard
    WHERE lifecycle_guard.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()
      AND lifecycle_guard.order_id = OLD.id
      AND lifecycle_guard.target_status = NEW.status
      AND lifecycle_guard.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(
        'nawasrah.customer_lifecycle_operation_id', true
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_V2_LIFECYCLE_COORDINATOR_REQUIRED: Customer V2 terminal transitions require the approved coordinator.';
  END IF;

  IF NEW.status = 'completed' THEN
    IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items item
        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id
          AND (item.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
            OR item.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id
          AND (instance.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
            OR instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_parcel_components component
        JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance
          ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id
        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id
          AND (component.cost_finalized_at IS NULL
            OR component.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation
        WHERE reservation.order_id = OLD.id
          AND reservation.reservation_state <> 'consumed'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id
          AND (
            instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (
              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(component.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT
              FROM public.order_parcel_components component
              WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id
            )
            OR instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (
              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(component.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::NUMERIC(30,6)
              FROM public.order_parcel_components component
              WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id
            )
          )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_items item
        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id
          AND item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'
          AND (
            item.cogs_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (
              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT
              FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
              WHERE instance.order_item_id = item.id
            )
            OR item.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (
              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::NUMERIC(30,6)
              FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
              WHERE instance.order_item_id = item.id
            )
          )
      )
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_COST_FINALIZATION_INCOMPLETE: Customer V2 completion cost is incomplete.';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    v_expected_reservation_state := CASE NEW.status
      WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'released' END;
    IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items item
        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id AND item.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance
        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id AND instance.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.order_parcel_components component
        JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance
          ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id
        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id
          AND component.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation
        WHERE reservation.order_id = OLD.id
          AND reservation.reservation_state <> v_expected_reservation_state
      )
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INCOMPLETE: Customer V2 reservation release is incomplete.';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-275"></a>
## guard_phase4_aftercare_consumption_history()

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase4_aftercare_consumption_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Phase-4 consumption evidence cannot be deleted.';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.consumption_state = 'draft'
    AND NEW.consumption_state = 'settled'
    AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_finalization_operation_id', true)
      = OLD.operation_id::TEXT
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, NEW.replacement_item_id,
      NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.consumed_quantity,
      NEW.consumption_kind, NEW.created_at
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.return_item_id, OLD.replacement_item_id,
      OLD.source_kind, OLD.source_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.consumed_quantity,
      OLD.consumption_kind, OLD.created_at
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  IF OLD.consumption_state = 'draft'
    AND NEW.consumption_state = 'cancelled'
    AND NEW.settled_at IS NULL
    AND CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_cancellation_operation_id', true)
      = OLD.operation_id::TEXT
    AND ROW(
      NEW.id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, NEW.replacement_item_id,
      NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.consumed_quantity,
      NEW.consumption_kind, NEW.created_at
    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(
      OLD.id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.return_item_id, OLD.replacement_item_id,
      OLD.source_kind, OLD.source_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.consumed_quantity,
      OLD.consumption_kind, OLD.created_at
    )
  THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
    MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Phase-4 consumption transition is not authorized.';
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase4_replacement_event_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Replacement evidence cannot be deleted.';
  END IF;
  IF CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_cancellation_operation_id', true) = OLD.operation_id::TEXT
    AND OLD.replacement_status = 'draft' AND NEW.replacement_status = 'cancelled'
    AND NEW.settled_at IS NULL
    AND NEW.issuance_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issuance_status
    AND NEW.issuance_coordinator_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issuance_coordinator_version
    AND NEW.issued_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issued_at
    AND ROW(NEW.id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.root_order_id,NEW.branch_id,NEW.warehouse_id,
      NEW.contract_version,NEW.original_completed_at_snapshot,NEW.reason,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.operation_id,OLD.root_order_id,OLD.branch_id,OLD.warehouse_id,
      OLD.contract_version,OLD.original_completed_at_snapshot,OLD.reason,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at)
  THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_finalization_operation_id', true) = OLD.operation_id::TEXT
    AND OLD.replacement_status = 'draft' AND NEW.replacement_status = 'settled'
    AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.issuance_status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issuance_status
    AND NEW.issuance_coordinator_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issuance_coordinator_version
    AND NEW.issued_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.issued_at
    AND ROW(NEW.id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.root_order_id,NEW.branch_id,NEW.warehouse_id,
      NEW.contract_version,NEW.original_completed_at_snapshot,NEW.reason,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.operation_id,OLD.root_order_id,OLD.branch_id,OLD.warehouse_id,
      OLD.contract_version,OLD.original_completed_at_snapshot,OLD.reason,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at)
  THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF OLD.replacement_status = 'settled' AND NEW.replacement_status = 'settled'
    AND OLD.settled_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.settled_at
    AND OLD.issuance_status = 'not_issued' AND NEW.issuance_status = 'issued'
    AND NEW.issued_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.issuance_coordinator_version = 403
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.phase43_replacement_issuance_guards guard_row
      WHERE guard_row.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()
        AND guard_row.operation_id = OLD.operation_id
        AND guard_row.replacement_event_id = OLD.id
    )
    AND ROW(NEW.id,NEW.operation_id,NEW.root_order_id,NEW.branch_id,NEW.warehouse_id,
      NEW.contract_version,NEW.original_completed_at_snapshot,NEW.reason,NEW.created_by,NEW.created_at)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.operation_id,OLD.root_order_id,OLD.branch_id,OLD.warehouse_id,
      OLD.contract_version,OLD.original_completed_at_snapshot,OLD.reason,OLD.created_by,OLD.created_at)
  THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
    MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Replacement evidence may change only at a protected finalization or issuance boundary.';
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_supplier_invoice_identity_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'SUPPLIER_INVOICE_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف هوية فاتورة المورد.';
  END IF;
  IF ROW(
    NEW.id, NEW.supplier_id, NEW.normalized_invoice_number,
    NEW.operation_id, NEW.supplier_receipt_id, NEW.purchase_receipt_id,
    NEW.created_at
  ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
    OLD.id, OLD.supplier_id, OLD.normalized_invoice_number,
    OLD.operation_id, OLD.supplier_receipt_id, OLD.purchase_receipt_id,
    OLD.created_at
  ) OR OLD.is_active = false OR NEW.is_active = true
    OR NEW.cancelled_at IS NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'SUPPLIER_INVOICE_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE: يسمح فقط بإغلاق هوية الفاتورة مرة واحدة.';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_erp_role(p_allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT
```

<a id="function-281"></a>
## import_go_live_products_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.import_go_live_products_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_replay JSONB;
  v_row JSONB;
  v_n INTEGER := 0;
  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_error TEXT;
  v_sku TEXT;
  v_barcode TEXT;
  v_name TEXT;
  v_category_id UUID;
  v_unit_id UUID;
  v_purchase_unit_id UUID;
  v_sale_unit_id UUID;
  v_units_per_purchase INTEGER;
  v_units_per_sale INTEGER;
  v_sale_price BIGINT;
  v_purchase_price BIGINT;
  v_cost BIGINT;
  v_min_stock INTEGER;
  v_count INTEGER;
  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_product JSONB;
  v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'استيراد منتجات بداية التشغيل');
  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();
  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN
    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('products', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);
    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN v_replay;
    END IF;
  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';
  END IF;

  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  LOOP
    v_n := v_n + 1;
    v_error := NULL;
    v_sku := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'sku'), '');
    v_barcode := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'barcode'), '');
    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'name_ar'), '');
    v_category_id := NULL; v_unit_id := NULL; v_purchase_unit_id := NULL; v_sale_unit_id := NULL;

    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object' THEN
      v_error := 'بيانات السطر غير صحيحة.';
    ELSIF v_sku IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_sku) > 64 THEN
      v_error := 'رمز الصنف SKU مطلوب وبحد أقصى 64 حرفاً.';
    ELSIF v_name IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_name) > 200 THEN
      v_error := 'اسم المنتج مطلوب وبحد أقصى 200 حرف.';
    ELSIF v_barcode IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_barcode) > 64 THEN
      v_error := 'الباركود أطول من المسموح.';
    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'units_per_purchase_unit', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$'
      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$' THEN
      v_error := 'عدد الحبات داخل الطرد يجب أن يكون رقماً صحيحاً أكبر من صفر.';
    ELSIF v_row ? 'parcel_only' AND jsonb_typeof(v_row->'parcel_only') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' THEN
      v_error := 'PARCEL209_METHOD_INVALID: حقل بيتباع بالطرد بس يجب أن يكون نعم أو لا.';
    ELSIF COALESCE((v_row->>'parcel_only')::BOOLEAN,false) AND (v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit')::INTEGER<=1 THEN
      v_error := 'PARCEL209_PARCEL_SIZE_REQUIRED: الطرد فقط يحتاج أكثر من وحدة في طرد البيع.';
    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'sale_package_price_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN
      v_error := 'سعر بيع الطرد يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر.';
    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'purchase_package_price_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'cost_per_base_unit_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'min_stock_level', '0') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN
      v_error := 'الأسعار والحد الأدنى يجب أن تكون أرقاماً موجبة صحيحة.';
    END IF;

    IF v_error IS NULL THEN
      SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_category_id FROM public.categories
      WHERE is_active AND name_ar = BTRIM(v_row->>'category_name');
      IF v_count <> 1 THEN
        v_error := CASE WHEN v_count = 0 THEN 'القسم غير موجود؛ أضفه أولاً أو صحّح اسمه.'
          ELSE 'اسم القسم مكرر؛ صحّح الأقسام أولاً.' END;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL THEN
      v_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'base_unit_name');
      IF v_unit_id IS NULL THEN
        v_error := 'الوحدة الصغرى غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل PKT).';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL THEN
      v_purchase_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'purchase_unit_name');
      IF v_purchase_unit_id IS NULL THEN
        v_error := 'وحدة طرد الشراء غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل CTN).';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL THEN
      v_sale_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'sale_unit_name');
      IF v_sale_unit_id IS NULL THEN
        v_error := 'وحدة طرد البيع غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل CTN).';
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products WHERE lower(sku) = lower(v_sku)) THEN
      v_error := 'رمز SKU مستخدم لمنتج موجود.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products WHERE barcode = v_barcode) THEN
      v_error := 'الباركود مستخدم لمنتج موجود.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) other
      WHERE lower(BTRIM(other->>'sku')) = lower(v_sku)) > 1 THEN
      v_error := 'رمز SKU مكرر داخل الملف.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL AND (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) other
      WHERE BTRIM(other->>'barcode') = v_barcode) > 1 THEN
      v_error := 'الباركود مكرر داخل الملف.';
    END IF;

    IF v_error IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'message', v_error);
      CONTINUE;
    END IF;
    IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN
      CONTINUE;
    END IF;

    v_units_per_purchase := (v_row->>'units_per_purchase_unit')::INTEGER;
    v_units_per_sale := (v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit')::INTEGER;
    v_sale_price := (v_row->>'sale_package_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
    v_purchase_price := (v_row->>'purchase_package_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
    v_cost := (v_row->>'cost_per_base_unit_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
    v_min_stock := COALESCE((v_row->>'min_stock_level')::INTEGER, 0);
    BEGIN
      v_product := public.create_product_with_opening_stock_v5(
        v_sku, v_barcode, v_name, NULL, v_category_id, NULL, v_unit_id,
        v_purchase_unit_id, v_units_per_purchase, v_purchase_price,
        v_sale_unit_id, v_units_per_sale, v_sale_price, v_cost, v_min_stock,
        NULL, NULL, 0, 'تعريف منتج من بداية التشغيل', NULL, COALESCE((v_row->>'parcel_only')::BOOLEAN,false));
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
        MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_ROW_FAILED: السطر ' || v_n || ': ' || SQLERRM;
    END;
    v_created := v_created || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'productId', v_product->>'product_id', 'sku', v_sku);
  END LOOP;

  IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', true, 'rowCount', v_n,
      'validCount', v_n - jsonb_array_length(v_errors), 'errors', v_errors);
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_errors) > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_INVALID: الملف يحتوي أسطراً غير صالحة؛ لم يُحفظ أي سطر.',
      DETAIL = v_errors::TEXT;
  END IF;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', false, 'idempotentReplay', false,
    'kind', 'products', 'rowCount', v_n, 'created', v_created);
  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(batch_kind, idempotency_key, request_hash, row_count, result, created_by)
  VALUES ('products', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), md5(p_rows::TEXT), v_n, v_result, v_user_id);
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_IMPORT_PRODUCTS', 'go_live_import_batches', NULL,
    jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), 'row_count', v_n,
      'skus', (SELECT jsonb_agg(c->>'sku') FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_created) c)));
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-282"></a>
## inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM public.inventory_damage_events
  WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id=p_branch_id) AND occurred_at>=p_from AND occurred_at<p_to
 ), reasons AS (
  SELECT reason_code,COUNT(*) AS count,SUM(quantity) AS quantity,SUM(loss_in_minor_units) AS amount,
   COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='customer_return'),0) AS included
  FROM scoped GROUP BY reason_code
 ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'totalInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units),0),
  'additionalInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='shop'),0),
  'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='customer_return'),0),
  'reasons',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',reason_code,'count',count,'quantity',quantity,
   'amountInMinorUnits',amount,'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',included) ORDER BY reason_code) FROM reasons),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) FROM scoped;
$function$
```

```sql
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$

    );
```

<a id="function-287"></a>
## issue_supplier_cheque_v1(p_supplier_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_bank_name text, p_cheque_number text, p_due_date date, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint, p_notes text, p_idempotency_key text, p_claim_id uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid, p_opening_only boolean)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.issue_supplier_cheque_v1(p_supplier_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_bank_name text, p_cheque_number text, p_due_date date, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint, p_notes text, p_idempotency_key text, p_claim_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_opening_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id UUID:=gen_random_uuid();v_request JSONB;v_replay JSONB;v_plan JSONB;v_payment UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'إصدار شيك مورد');
  v_request:=jsonb_build_object('action','issue','supplier',p_supplier_id,'branch',p_branch_id,'bank',btrim(p_bank_name),
    'number',btrim(p_cheque_number),'due',p_due_date,'amount',p_amount_in_minor_units,'notes',NULLIF(btrim(p_notes),''),'claim',p_claim_id,'purchaseOrder',p_purchase_order_id,'openingOnly',p_opening_only);
  v_replay:=public.cheque_replay_internal(p_idempotency_key,v_request);IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.branches WHERE id=p_branch_id AND is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر فرعاً نشطاً.';END IF;
  -- Same PO-before-supplier row lock order as the existing133 writer.
  IF p_purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=p_purchase_order_id AND supplier_id=p_supplier_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء لا يتبع المورد المحدد.';END IF;
  END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id AND is_active FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';END IF;
  v_plan:=public.cheque_supplier_plan_internal(p_supplier_id,p_amount_in_minor_units,p_claim_id,p_purchase_order_id,p_opening_only);
  INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheques(id,tracking_number,direction,cheque_number,bank_name,due_date,amount_in_minor_units,
    supplier_id,branch_id,notes,created_by,changed_by)
  VALUES(v_id,'CHQ-'||lpad(nextval('public.deferred_cheque_number_seq')::TEXT,8,'0'),'outgoing',btrim(p_cheque_number),
    btrim(p_bank_name),p_due_date,p_amount_in_minor_units,p_supplier_id,p_branch_id,NULLIF(btrim(p_notes),''),auth.uid(),auth.uid());
  INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)
  VALUES('supplier',p_supplier_id,lower(btrim(p_bank_name)),btrim(p_cheque_number),v_id);
  v_payment:=public.cheque_pay_supplier_internal(v_id,p_supplier_id,v_plan,p_purchase_order_id);
  UPDATE public.deferred_cheques SET supplier_payment_id=v_payment WHERE id=v_id;
  RETURN public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_id,'issued',NULL,NULL,p_idempotency_key,v_request);
END;
$function$
```

## mark_all_stock_alerts_read()

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_all_stock_alerts_read()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner',
      'admin',
      'manager',
      'accountant',
      'sales',
      'warehouse_keeper',
      'delivery_driver'
    ],
    'تحديث حالة تنبيهات المخزون'
  );

  INSERT INTO public.stock_alert_reads (
    stock_alert_id,
    user_id,
    read_at
  )
  SELECT id, v_user_id, NOW()
  FROM public.stock_alerts
  WHERE status = 'active'
  ON CONFLICT (stock_alert_id, user_id)
  DO UPDATE SET read_at = EXCLUDED.read_at;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'updatedCount', v_count
  );
END;
$function$
```

## mark_stock_alert_read(p_stock_alert_id uuid)

Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_stock_alert_read(p_stock_alert_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY[
      'owner',
      'admin',
      'manager',
      'accountant',
      'sales',
      'warehouse_keeper',
      'delivery_driver'
    ],
    'تحديث حالة تنبيه المخزون'
  );

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.stock_alerts
    WHERE id = p_stock_alert_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تنبيه المخزون المحدد غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.stock_alert_reads (
    stock_alert_id,
    user_id,
    read_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_stock_alert_id,
    v_user_id,
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (stock_alert_id, user_id)
  DO UPDATE SET read_at = EXCLUDED.read_at;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-290"></a>
## normalize_customer_phone(p_phone text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: INVOKER; volatility: `i`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_customer_phone(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT regexp_replace(TRIM(p_phone), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS digits
  ),
  international_prefix_removed AS (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN digits LIKE '00962%' THEN SUBSTRING(digits FROM 3)
      ELSE digits
    END AS digits
    FROM cleaned
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN digits ~ '^962[0-9]{9}$' THEN '0' || SUBSTRING(digits FROM 4)
    WHEN digits ~ '^7[0-9]{8}$' THEN '0' || digits
    ELSE digits
  END
  FROM international_prefix_removed;
$function$
```

<a id="function-292"></a>
## open_cash_shift(p_branch_id uuid, p_opening_cash_in_minor_units bigint)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.open_cash_shift(p_branch_id uuid, p_opening_cash_in_minor_units bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_shift_id UUID;
  v_shift_number TEXT;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'فتح وردية الصندوق'
  );
  IF COALESCE(p_opening_cash_in_minor_units, -1) < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'العهدة الافتتاحية لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.branches WHERE id = p_branch_id AND is_active) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الفرع المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id AND status = 'open') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'توجد وردية مفتوحة بالفعل لهذا الفرع.';
  END IF;

  v_shift_number := 'SHF-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('public.cash_shift_number_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0');
  INSERT INTO public.cash_shifts (
    shift_number, branch_id, opened_by, opening_cash_in_minor_units,
    expected_cash_in_minor_units
  ) VALUES (
    v_shift_number, p_branch_id, v_user_id, p_opening_cash_in_minor_units,
    p_opening_cash_in_minor_units
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_shift_id;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'OPEN_CASH_SHIFT', 'cash_shifts', v_shift_id,
    jsonb_build_object('shift_number', v_shift_number, 'branch_id', p_branch_id,
      'opening_cash_in_minor_units', p_opening_cash_in_minor_units));

  RETURN public.get_cash_shift_summary(v_shift_id) || jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 'message', 'تم فتح الوردية وربطها بالصندوق بنجاح.'
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-294"></a>
## owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_kind text, event_at timestamp with time zone, direction text, amount_in_minor_units bigint, withdrawal_id uuid, withdrawal_number text, branch_id uuid, shift_id uuid, actor_id uuid, reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT 'withdrawal', w.created_at, 'out', w.amount_in_minor_units, w.id, w.withdrawal_number,
    w.branch_id, w.cash_shift_id, w.created_by, w.reason
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals w
  WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR w.branch_id = p_branch_id)
    AND w.created_at >= p_from AND w.created_at < p_to
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return', r.reversed_at, 'in', r.amount_in_minor_units, w.id, w.withdrawal_number,
    shift.branch_id, r.effective_shift_id, r.reversed_by, r.reason
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  JOIN public.cash_shifts shift ON shift.id = r.effective_shift_id
  WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR shift.branch_id = p_branch_id)
    AND r.reversed_at >= p_from AND r.reversed_at < p_to
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return_voided', r.voided_at, 'out', r.amount_in_minor_units, w.id, w.withdrawal_number,
    shift.branch_id, r.effective_shift_id, r.voided_by, NULL
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  JOIN public.cash_shifts shift ON shift.id = r.effective_shift_id
  WHERE r.voided_at IS NOT NULL
    AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR shift.branch_id = p_branch_id)
    AND r.voided_at >= p_from AND r.voided_at < p_to;
$function$
```

<a id="function-297"></a>
## owner_withdrawal_integrity_issues_internal()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_withdrawal_integrity_issues_internal()
 RETURNS TABLE(issue text, record_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT 'withdrawal_branch_mismatch', w.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals w JOIN public.cash_shifts s ON s.id = w.cash_shift_id
  WHERE s.branch_id <> w.branch_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'withdrawal_missing_audit', w.id FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals w
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_logs a
    WHERE a.action = 'CREATE_OWNER_CASH_WITHDRAWAL' AND a.entity_id = w.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return_amount_mismatch', r.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  WHERE r.amount_in_minor_units <> w.amount_in_minor_units
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return_branch_mismatch', r.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  JOIN public.cash_shifts s ON s.id = r.effective_shift_id
  WHERE s.branch_id <> w.branch_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return_missing_audit', r.id FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  WHERE r.via_shift_reversal_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_logs a
    WHERE a.action = 'REVERSE_OWNER_CASH_WITHDRAWAL' AND a.entity_id = r.withdrawal_id
      AND a.details->>'reversal_id' = r.id::TEXT)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'shift_reversal_link_mismatch', r.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.cash_shift_reversals sr ON sr.id = r.via_shift_reversal_id
  JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  WHERE sr.shift_id <> r.effective_shift_id OR w.cash_shift_id <> r.effective_shift_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'void_link_mismatch', r.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.cash_shift_reversals sr ON sr.id = r.voided_by_shift_reversal_id
  WHERE sr.shift_id <> r.effective_shift_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'reversed_shift_withdrawal_not_returned', w.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals w JOIN public.cash_shifts s ON s.id = w.cash_shift_id
  WHERE s.status = 'reversed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
    WHERE r.withdrawal_id = w.id AND r.voided_at IS NULL)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'reversed_shift_return_still_active', r.id
  FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
  JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
  JOIN public.cash_shifts s ON s.id = r.effective_shift_id
  WHERE s.status = 'reversed' AND r.voided_at IS NULL AND w.cash_shift_id <> r.effective_shift_id;
$function$
```

<a id="function-299"></a>
## owner_withdrawal_reject_mutation()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_withdrawal_reject_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Nested so OLD/NEW columns are only read on the reversals table (PL/pgSQL
  -- does not short-circuit a single IF condition).
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME = 'owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals'
    AND current_setting('nawasrah.owner_withdrawal_void', true) = 'on'
  THEN
    IF to_jsonb(OLD)->>'voided_at' IS NULL AND to_jsonb(NEW)->>'voided_at' IS NOT NULL
      AND (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['voided_at', 'voided_by', 'voided_by_shift_reversal_id'])
        = (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['voided_at', 'voided_by', 'voided_by_shift_reversal_id'])
    THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_IMMUTABLE: سحب المالك وعكسه لا يُعدّلان ولا يُحذفان؛ التصحيح بقيد عكسي.';
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-302"></a>
## owner_withdrawal_shift_reversal_plan_internal(p_shift_id uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_withdrawal_shift_reversal_plan_internal(p_shift_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH own AS (
    SELECT w.id, w.withdrawal_number, w.amount_in_minor_units, r.id AS reversal_id, r.effective_shift_id
    FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals w
    LEFT JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r ON r.withdrawal_id = w.id AND r.voided_at IS NULL
    WHERE w.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id
  ), foreign_returns AS (
    SELECT r.id, r.withdrawal_id, w.withdrawal_number, r.amount_in_minor_units, w.cash_shift_id
    FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals r
    JOIN public.owner_cash_withdrawals w ON w.id = r.withdrawal_id
    WHERE r.effective_shift_id = p_shift_id AND r.voided_at IS NULL AND w.cash_shift_id <> p_shift_id
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'canExecute', NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM own WHERE reversal_id IS NOT NULL AND effective_shift_id <> p_shift_id),
    'blockedReason', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM own WHERE reversal_id IS NOT NULL AND effective_shift_id <> p_shift_id)
      THEN 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_RETURNED_IN_OTHER_SHIFT: سحب من هذه الوردية أُعيد في وردية أخرى؛ لا يمكن احتواؤه في عكس هذه الوردية.' END,
    'withdrawalsToReverse', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('withdrawalId', id, 'withdrawalNumber', withdrawal_number,
      'amountInMinorUnits', amount_in_minor_units) ORDER BY withdrawal_number) FROM own WHERE reversal_id IS NULL), '[]'::JSONB),
    'returnsToVoid', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('reversalId', id, 'withdrawalId', withdrawal_id,
      'withdrawalNumber', withdrawal_number, 'amountInMinorUnits', amount_in_minor_units, 'originalShiftId', cash_shift_id)
      ORDER BY withdrawal_number) FROM foreign_returns), '[]'::JSONB),
    'cashBackToDrawerInMinorUnits', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM own WHERE reversal_id IS NULL), 0),
    'cashOutAgainInMinorUnits', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FROM foreign_returns), 0)
  );
$function$
```
