```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_erp_staff_password_reset(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_full_name TEXT;
  v_target_is_owner BOOLEAN := false;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مستخدم');
  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_user_id = auth.uid() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور حسابك الحالي من هذه الشاشة.';
  END IF;
  SELECT profile.full_name INTO v_full_name FROM public.profiles profile WHERE profile.id = p_user_id;
  IF v_full_name IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير موجود.';
  END IF;
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles assignment
    JOIN public.roles role ON role.id = assignment.role_id
    WHERE assignment.user_id = p_user_id AND role.code = 'owner'
  ) INTO v_target_is_owner;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (
    auth.uid(),
    CASE WHEN v_target_is_owner THEN 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مالك نظام' ELSE 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مستخدم' END,
    'staff_account', p_user_id,
    jsonb_build_object('full_name', v_full_name, 'is_owner', v_target_is_owner)
  );
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'userId', p_user_id, 'message', 'تم تسجيل إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور.');
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-448"></a>
## record_external_monitoring_snapshot(p_checks jsonb, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_external_monitoring_snapshot(p_checks jsonb, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_item JSONB;
  v_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_allowed CONSTANT TEXT[] := ARRAY[
    'external:backup:erp','external:backup:n8n','external:backup:restore',
    'external:infrastructure:docker','external:infrastructure:n8n',
    'external:deployment:github','external:deployment:uptime',
    'external:deployment:cloudflare-admin','external:deployment:cloudflare-customer'
  ];
BEGIN
  IF p_observed_at IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_checks)<>'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(p_checks)>20 OR octet_length(p_checks::TEXT)>16384
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring snapshot.'; END IF;
  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_checks)
  LOOP
    IF NOT (v_item->>'key'=ANY(v_allowed))
      OR v_item->>'category' NOT IN ('backup','infrastructure','deployment')
      OR v_item->>'status' NOT IN ('healthy','warning','critical','unknown')
      OR v_item->>'severity' NOT IN ('low','medium','high','critical')
      OR COALESCE((v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,-1)<0
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring item.'; END IF;
    PERFORM public._set_advanced_monitoring_check(
      v_item->>'key',v_item->>'category','external',v_item->>'status',
      v_item->>'severity',(v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,
      LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(v_item->>'summary'),''),'External check'),240),
      COALESCE(v_item->'details','{}'::JSONB),p_observed_at);
    v_count:=v_count+1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-449"></a>
## record_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_envelope JSONB:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('branch',p_branch_id,'rows',p_rows));
  v_replay JSONB;v_plan JSONB;v_locked_rows JSONB;v_row JSONB;v_party RECORD;v_id UUID;v_index INTEGER:=0;v_created JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'تسجيل الشيكات القائمة قبل التشغيل');
  v_replay:=public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,v_envelope);
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.go_live_import_batches WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key AND created_by<>auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_KEY_CONFLICT: المفتاح يخص عملية لفاعل آخر.';END IF;
  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;
  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();
  -- Discover all parties before row locks. Same customer gate as collection;
  -- supplier rows are locked in UUID order before any cheque row is created.
  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;
  v_locked_rows:=v_plan->'rows';
  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r
    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||v_party.id::TEXT,0));
  END LOOP;
  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r
    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=v_party.id AND NOT is_deleted FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود أو حُذف؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r
    WHERE COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=v_party.id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;
  END LOOP;
  -- Revalidate duplicates under party gates;preview is never write authority.
  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;
  IF v_plan->'rows' IS DISTINCT FROM v_locked_rows THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_PARTIES_CHANGED: تغيّرت هوية الأطراف أثناء الحفظ؛ أعد المعاينة.';
  END IF;
  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') LOOP
    v_index:=v_index+1;v_id:=gen_random_uuid();
    INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheques(id,tracking_number,direction,origin,cheque_number,bank_name,due_date,amount_in_minor_units,
      customer_id,supplier_id,endorsed_supplier_id,branch_id,status,original_debt_at,notes,created_by,changed_by)
    VALUES(v_id,'CHQ-'||lpad(nextval('public.deferred_cheque_number_seq')::TEXT,8,'0'),v_row->>'direction','opening',
      v_row->>'number',v_row->>'bank',(v_row->>'dueDate')::DATE,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT,
      (v_row->>'customerId')::UUID,(v_row->>'supplierId')::UUID,(v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID,p_branch_id,
      v_row->>'status',(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,v_row->>'notes',auth.uid(),auth.uid());
    FOR v_party IN SELECT 'customer'::TEXT kind,(v_row->>'customerId')::UUID id WHERE v_row->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL
      UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier',COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID
        WHERE COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL LOOP
      INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)
      VALUES(v_party.kind,v_party.id,lower(v_row->>'bank'),v_row->>'number',v_id);
      INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheque_allocations(cheque_id,party_kind,party_id,origin_kind,origin_id,original_debt_at,amount_in_minor_units)
      VALUES(v_id,v_party.kind,v_party.id,'opening_cheque',v_id,(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT);
    END LOOP;
    v_result:=public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_id,'opening_registered',NULL,NULL,
      'opening-cheque-'||md5(p_idempotency_key)||'-'||v_index::TEXT,
      jsonb_build_object('action','opening_register','branch',p_branch_id,'batchKey',p_idempotency_key,'row',v_row));
    v_created:=v_created||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',v_id,'trackingNumber',v_result#>>'{cheque,tracking_number}'));
  END LOOP;
  v_result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotentReplay',false,'created',v_created,'rowCount',v_index,
    'parties',v_plan->'parties','balanceEffectInMinorUnits',0);
  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(batch_kind,idempotency_key,request_hash,row_count,result,created_by)
  VALUES('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,md5(v_envelope::TEXT),v_index,v_result,auth.uid());
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-450"></a>
## record_supplier_opening_balances_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean, p_confirm_new_suppliers boolean)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_supplier_opening_balances_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false, p_confirm_new_suppliers boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_replay JSONB;
  v_row JSONB;
  v_n INTEGER := 0;
  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_error TEXT;
  v_supplier_id UUID;
  v_count INTEGER;
  v_warning BOOLEAN;
  v_name TEXT;
  v_phone TEXT;
  v_other TEXT;
  v_new_key TEXT;
  v_new JSONB := '{}'::JSONB;
  v_created_suppliers JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_date DATE;
  v_direction TEXT;
  v_notes TEXT;
  v_today DATE := (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;
  v_valid JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_batch_id UUID;
  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;
  v_entry public.supplier_opening_balances%ROWTYPE;
  v_payable BIGINT := 0;
  v_advance BIGINT := 0;
  v_supplier UUID;
  v_signed BIGINT;
  v_result JSONB;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إدخال أرصدة الموردين الافتتاحية');
  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();
  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN
    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('supplier_opening', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);
    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN v_replay;
    END IF;
  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';
  END IF;

  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  LOOP
    v_n := v_n + 1;
    v_error := NULL; v_warning := false; v_supplier_id := NULL; v_date := NULL; v_new_key := NULL; v_other := NULL;
    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'supplier_name'), '');
    v_phone := NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_phone', '')), '');
    v_direction := v_row->>'direction';
    v_notes := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'notes'), '');
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object' THEN
      v_error := 'بيانات السطر غير صحيحة.';
    ELSIF v_direction IS NULL OR v_direction NOT IN ('payable', 'advance') THEN
      v_error := 'اتجاه الرصيد يجب أن يكون "له" أو "عليه".';
    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN
      v_error := 'المبلغ يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر وبثلاث منازل عشرية كحد أقصى.';
    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'original_balance_date', '') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN
      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي مطلوب بصيغة YYYY-MM-DD.';
    ELSIF v_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes) > 300 THEN
      v_error := 'الملاحظة أطول من 300 حرف.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL THEN
      BEGIN
        v_date := (v_row->>'original_balance_date')::DATE;
      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي غير صحيح.';
      END;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_date > v_today THEN
      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي لا يمكن أن يكون في المستقبل.';
    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_date < DATE '2000-01-01' THEN
      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي أقدم من المسموح (2000-01-01).';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_name) > 150 THEN
      v_error := 'اسم المورد أطول من المسموح.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_id', '') <> '' THEN
      IF v_row->>'supplier_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers
        WHERE id = (v_row->>'supplier_id')::UUID AND is_active;
      END IF;
      IF v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN v_error := 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.'; END IF;
    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL AND v_phone IS NULL THEN
      v_error := 'اسم المورد أو هاتفه مطلوب لمطابقته.';
    ELSIF v_error IS NULL THEN
      IF v_phone IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers
        WHERE is_active AND NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(phone, '')), '') = v_phone;
        IF v_count > 1 THEN
          v_supplier_id := NULL;
          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الهاتف؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';
        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN
          v_supplier_id := NULL;
        END IF;
      ELSE
        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers
        WHERE is_active AND BTRIM(company_name) = v_name;
        IF v_count > 1 THEN
          v_supplier_id := NULL;
          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الاسم؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';
        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN
          v_supplier_id := NULL;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      IF v_error IS NULL AND v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT company_name || COALESCE(' — ' || NULLIF(phone, ''), '') INTO v_other FROM public.suppliers
        WHERE is_active AND v_name IS NOT NULL
          AND public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(company_name) = public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(v_name)
        ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1;
        IF v_other IS NOT NULL THEN
          v_warning := true;
          v_error := 'تحذير: يوجد مورد باسم مطابق أو مشابه '
            || CASE WHEN v_phone IS NULL THEN 'والسطر بلا هاتف' ELSE 'وهاتف مختلف' END
            || ' (' || v_other || ')؛ صحّح السطر أو أدخل الرصيد يدوياً. لن يُنشأ مورد مكرر.';
        ELSIF v_name IS NULL THEN
          v_error := 'لا يوجد مورد بهذا الهاتف، واسم المورد مطلوب لإضافته كمورد جديد.';
        ELSE
          v_new_key := public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(v_name);
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) prior
      WHERE COALESCE(prior->>'supplier_id', prior->>'new_key') = COALESCE(v_supplier_id::TEXT, v_new_key)) THEN
      v_error := 'المورد مكرر داخل الملف؛ اجعل لكل مورد سطراً واحداً بصافي رصيده.';
    END IF;
    IF v_error IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'message', v_error,
        'kind', CASE WHEN v_warning THEN 'warning' ELSE 'error' END);
    ELSE
      IF v_new_key IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_new := v_new || jsonb_build_object(v_new_key, jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'name', v_name, 'phone', v_phone));
      END IF;
      v_valid := v_valid || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'supplier_id', v_supplier_id, 'new_key', v_new_key,
        'direction', v_direction, 'amount_in_minor_units', (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT,
        'original_balance_date', v_date, 'notes', v_notes);
      IF v_direction = 'payable' THEN
        v_payable := v_payable + (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
      ELSE
        v_advance := v_advance + (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', true, 'rowCount', v_n,
      'validCount', jsonb_array_length(v_valid), 'errors', v_errors,
      'newSuppliers', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'row')::INTEGER)
        FROM jsonb_each(v_new)), '[]'::JSONB),
      'payableTotalInMinorUnits', v_payable, 'advanceTotalInMinorUnits', v_advance);
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v_errors) > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_INVALID: الملف يحتوي أسطراً غير صالحة أو تحذيرات؛ لم يُحفظ أي سطر.',
      DETAIL = v_errors::TEXT;
  END IF;
  IF v_new <> '{}'::JSONB AND NOT COALESCE(p_confirm_new_suppliers, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_NEW_PARTIES_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: سيُضاف ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_new))
        || ' مورد جديد؛ أكّد إضافتهم قبل الحفظ.';
  END IF;

  FOR v_new_key IN SELECT key FROM jsonb_each(v_new) ORDER BY (value->>'row')::INTEGER
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.suppliers(company_name, phone, is_active)
    VALUES (v_new->v_new_key->>'name', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone', true)
    RETURNING id INTO v_supplier_id;
    v_new := jsonb_set(v_new, ARRAY[v_new_key, 'supplier_id'], to_jsonb(v_supplier_id));
    v_created_suppliers := v_created_suppliers || jsonb_build_object('supplierId', v_supplier_id,
      'name', v_new->v_new_key->>'name', 'phone', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone');
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
    VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SUPPLIER_CREATED', 'suppliers', v_supplier_id,
      jsonb_build_object('company_name', v_new->v_new_key->>'name', 'phone', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone'));
  END LOOP;
  v_valid := (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN v->>'supplier_id' IS NULL
      THEN jsonb_set(v, '{supplier_id}', v_new->(v->>'new_key')->'supplier_id') ELSE v END
      ORDER BY (v->>'row')::INTEGER), '[]'::JSONB)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) v);

  -- Lock suppliers in a stable order before changing their stored balances.
  FOR v_supplier IN SELECT DISTINCT (v->>'supplier_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) v ORDER BY 1
  LOOP
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id = v_supplier FOR UPDATE;
  END LOOP;

  v_batch_id := gen_random_uuid();
  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid)
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.supplier_opening_balances(entry_number, supplier_id, direction,
      amount_in_minor_units, original_balance_date, notes, batch_id, created_by)
    VALUES ('SOB-' || LPAD(nextval('public.supplier_opening_balance_number_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0'),
      (v_row->>'supplier_id')::UUID, v_row->>'direction', (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT,
      (v_row->>'original_balance_date')::DATE, v_row->>'notes', v_batch_id, v_user_id)
    RETURNING * INTO v_entry;
    v_signed := CASE WHEN v_entry.direction = 'payable' THEN v_entry.amount_in_minor_units
      ELSE -v_entry.amount_in_minor_units END;
    UPDATE public.suppliers
    SET current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units + v_signed, updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = v_entry.supplier_id;
    v_created := v_created || jsonb_build_object('row', (v_row->>'row')::INTEGER,
      'entryId', v_entry.id, 'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'supplierId', v_entry.supplier_id,
      'direction', v_entry.direction, 'amountInMinorUnits', v_entry.amount_in_minor_units,
      'originalBalanceDate', v_entry.original_balance_date);
  END LOOP;
  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', false, 'idempotentReplay', false,
    'kind', 'supplier_opening', 'batchId', v_batch_id, 'rowCount', v_n,
    'payableTotalInMinorUnits', v_payable, 'advanceTotalInMinorUnits', v_advance, 'created', v_created,
    'createdSuppliers', v_created_suppliers);
  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(id, batch_kind, idempotency_key, request_hash, row_count, result, created_by)
  VALUES (v_batch_id, 'supplier_opening', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), md5(p_rows::TEXT), v_n, v_result, v_user_id);
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SUPPLIER_OPENING_BALANCES', 'go_live_import_batches', v_batch_id,
    jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), 'row_count', v_n,
      'payable_total_in_minor_units', v_payable, 'advance_total_in_minor_units', v_advance,
      'created_suppliers', v_created_suppliers,
      'entries', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('entry_number', c->>'entryNumber',
        'supplier_id', c->>'supplierId', 'direction', c->>'direction',
        'amount_in_minor_units', (c->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,
        'original_balance_date', c->>'originalBalanceDate')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_created) c)));
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-451"></a>
## record_supplier_payment(p_supplier_id uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint, p_payment_method text, p_reference_number text, p_payment_date timestamp with time zone, p_notes text, p_idempotency_key text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_supplier_payment(p_supplier_id uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_payment_method text DEFAULT 'cash'::text, p_reference_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_payment_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');
  v_existing public.supplier_payments%ROWTYPE;
  v_result JSONB;
  v_po public.purchase_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_active_paid NUMERIC;
  v_actual_payable NUMERIC;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'تسجيل دفعات الموردين'
  );

  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لتسجيل دفعة مورد.';
  END IF;
  IF p_payment_method IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22004',
      MESSAGE = 'SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED: طريقة دفع المورد مطلوبة.';
  END IF;
  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع تكرار دفعة المورد غير صالح.';
  END IF;

  IF p_payment_method IN ('check','cheque') THEN
    PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'إصدار شيك مورد');
    IF NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1 FROM public.cheque_party_keys k
      JOIN public.deferred_cheques c ON c.id=k.cheque_id
      WHERE k.party_kind='supplier' AND k.party_id=p_supplier_id
        AND k.registered_by=v_user_id AND k.registration_txid=txid_current()
        AND c.status='pending' AND c.supplier_payment_id IS NULL
        AND c.amount_in_minor_units=p_amount_in_minor_units
        AND k.bank_key=c.bank_key AND k.cheque_number=c.cheque_number
        AND p_reference_number=c.cheque_number
        AND v_key='cheque-supplier-'||c.id::TEXT
        AND ((c.direction='outgoing' AND c.supplier_id=p_supplier_id)
          OR(c.direction='incoming' AND c.endorsed_supplier_id IS NULL))
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: الشيك يحتاج البنك والرقم والاستحقاق عبر دورة الشيكات؛ لا تسجيل مباشر.';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Serialize equal retries before the underlying implementation mutates the
  -- purchase order, supplier balance, cash shift, and audit history.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended(
      v_user_id::TEXT || ':purchase_order_payment:' || v_key,
      0
    )
  );

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
  FROM public.supplier_payments
  WHERE created_by = v_user_id
    AND idempotency_scope = 'purchase_order_payment'
    AND idempotency_key = v_key
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_supplier_id
      OR v_existing.purchase_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_purchase_order_id
      OR v_existing.amount_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount_in_minor_units
      OR v_existing.payment_method IS DISTINCT FROM p_payment_method
      OR NULLIF(BTRIM(v_existing.reference_number),'') IS DISTINCT FROM NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reference_number),'')
    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: استُخدم مفتاح الدفعة لطلب مختلف.'; END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'idempotent', true,
      'payment_id', v_existing.id,
      'supplier_id', v_existing.supplier_id,
      'purchase_order_id', v_existing.purchase_order_id,
      'amount_in_minor_units', v_existing.amount_in_minor_units,
      'message', 'تمت معالجة طلب الدفعة سابقًا.'
    );
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_payment_shift_internal(
    (SELECT branch_id FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id),
    p_payment_method, p_amount_in_minor_units
  );
  IF p_purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=p_purchase_order_id FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND OR v_po.supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_supplier_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء لا يتبع المورد المحدد.';
    END IF;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units),0) INTO v_active_paid
    FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id AND NOT is_reversed;
    v_actual_payable := GREATEST(v_po.total_in_minor_units::NUMERIC,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)
        FROM public.purchase_receipts r WHERE r.purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id
          AND r.status='completed' AND r.phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL),0)
      +COALESCE((SELECT payable::NUMERIC FROM public.phase133_legacy_po_payables_internal()
        WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id),0));
    IF v_active_paid+p_amount_in_minor_units > v_actual_payable THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE=format(
        'SUPPLIER_PO_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE: المستحق الفعلي %s، المدفوع %s، الحد الأقصى المسموح الآن %s دينار.',
        v_actual_payable/1000.0,v_active_paid/1000.0,GREATEST(v_actual_payable-v_active_paid,0)/1000.0),
        DETAIL=jsonb_build_object('payable',v_actual_payable,'paid',v_active_paid,
          'maxAllowed',GREATEST(v_actual_payable-v_active_paid,0))::TEXT;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  v_result := public._record_supplier_payment_impl(
    p_supplier_id,
    p_purchase_order_id,
    p_amount_in_minor_units,
    p_payment_method,
    p_reference_number,
    p_payment_date,
    p_notes
  );

  -- One new committed payment reduces supplier debt even when it precedes
  -- receiving. The idempotent branch above never reaches this UPDATE.
  UPDATE public.suppliers
  SET current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units - p_amount_in_minor_units,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_supplier_id;

  UPDATE public.supplier_payments
  SET
    idempotency_scope = 'purchase_order_payment',
    idempotency_key = v_key
  WHERE id = (v_result->>'payment_id')::UUID
    AND created_by = v_user_id
    AND idempotency_scope IS NULL
    AND idempotency_key IS NULL;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر تثبيت مفتاح منع تكرار دفعة المورد.';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('idempotent', false);
END;
$function$
```

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_flavor_master_inventory_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.products p
    WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id
      AND p.is_flavor_master = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'المنتج الأساسي للنكهات مخصص للتجميع فقط؛ اختر نكهة محددة لتغيير المخزون.';
  END IF;

<a id="function-454"></a>
## reject_stocked_product_flavor_master_promotion()

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_stocked_product_flavor_master_promotion()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.is_flavor_master = true
     AND COALESCE(OLD.is_flavor_master, false) = false
     AND (
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM public.inventory_balances ib
         WHERE ib.product_id = NEW.id
           AND (ib.on_hand_quantity <> 0 OR ib.reserved_quantity <> 0)
       )
       OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM public.inventory_movements im
         WHERE im.product_id = NEW.id
       )
     )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'لا يمكن تحويل صنف لديه رصيد أو تاريخ مخزني إلى منتج أساسي للنكهات.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
```

## reorder_product_flavors_v1(p_master_product_id uuid, p_ordered_flavor_ids uuid[])

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reorder_product_flavors_v1(p_master_product_id uuid, p_ordered_flavor_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_expected_count INTEGER;
  v_requested_count INTEGER;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],
    'ترتيب نكهات المنتج'
  );

  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.products
  WHERE id = p_master_product_id
    AND flavor_master_product_id IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج الأساسي غير موجود.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_expected_count
  FROM public.products
  WHERE flavor_master_product_id = p_master_product_id;

  v_requested_count := COALESCE(CARDINALITY(p_ordered_flavor_ids), 0);
  IF v_requested_count <> v_expected_count THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب إرسال جميع نكهات المنتج عند ترتيبها.';
  END IF;
  IF (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT requested.flavor_id)
    FROM UNNEST(p_ordered_flavor_ids) AS requested(flavor_id)
  ) <> v_requested_count THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قائمة ترتيب النكهات تحتوي على تكرار.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(p_ordered_flavor_ids) AS requested(flavor_id)
    LEFT JOIN public.products p
      ON p.id = requested.flavor_id
      AND p.flavor_master_product_id = p_master_product_id
    WHERE p.id IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قائمة ترتيب النكهات غير صالحة.';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.products p
  SET
    flavor_sort_order = requested.position::INTEGER * 10,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM UNNEST(p_ordered_flavor_ids) WITH ORDINALITY
    AS requested(flavor_id, position)
  WHERE p.id = requested.flavor_id
    AND p.flavor_master_product_id = p_master_product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
    user_id,
    action,
    entity_name,
    entity_id,
    details
  ) VALUES (
    auth.uid(),
    'REORDER_PRODUCT_FLAVORS',
    'products',
    p_master_product_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'ordered_flavor_ids', to_jsonb(p_ordered_flavor_ids),
      'flavor_count', v_requested_count
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', TRUE,
    'productId', p_master_product_id,
    'message', 'تم ترتيب النكهات.'
  );
END;
$function$
```

## report_admin_runtime_incident(p_fingerprint text, p_area text)

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_admin_runtime_incident(p_fingerprint text, p_area text DEFAULT 'admin_render'::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales','warehouse_keeper','orders','delivery_driver','view_only'],
    'تسجيل حادث تقني'
  );
  IF p_fingerprint !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' OR p_area NOT IN ('admin_render','admin_global') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid runtime incident fingerprint.';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.advanced_monitoring_runtime_incidents(
    fingerprint,application,area,occurrence_count,first_seen_at,last_seen_at,resolved_at,updated_at
  ) VALUES (p_fingerprint,'admin',p_area,1,NOW(),NOW(),NULL,NOW())
  ON CONFLICT(fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET occurrence_count=
    advanced_monitoring_runtime_incidents.occurrence_count+1,
    last_seen_at=NOW(),resolved_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW();
END;
$function$
```

## resolve_legacy_supplier_receipt_replay_v1(p_idempotency_key uuid)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `s`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_legacy_supplier_receipt_replay_v1(p_idempotency_key uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_receipt public.supplier_receipts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],
    'مراجعة سند استلام تاريخي'
  );
  IF v_user_id IS NULL OR p_idempotency_key IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('found', false);
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_receipt
  FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt
  WHERE receipt.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key
    AND receipt.received_by = v_user_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    -- No distinction between an absent key and another actor's key.
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('found', false);
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'found', true,
    'receipt_id', v_receipt.id,
    'receipt_number', v_receipt.receipt_number,
    'received_at', v_receipt.received_at,
    'total_in_minor_units', v_receipt.total_in_minor_units,
    'status', v_receipt.status
  );
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-460"></a>
## reverse_cash_shift_with_operations(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_cash_shift_with_operations(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID;
  v_plan JSONB;
  v_result JSONB;
  v_reversal_id UUID;
  v_item JSONB;
  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');
  v_reversed_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_reversed_amount BIGINT := 0;
  v_voided_count INTEGER := 0;
  v_voided_amount BIGINT := 0;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := public.assert_reversal_owner(
    'إلغاء الوردية وعكس جميع عملياتها'
  );
  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_full_shift_context_internal(p_shift_id);

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.sales_return_events return_event
    WHERE return_event.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id
      AND return_event.settlement_coordinator_version = 402
      AND return_event.settlement_status = 'settled'
      AND return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units > 0
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_SETTLED_RETURN_REFUND_DEPENDENCY: Reverse the settled Return through an approved future reversal contract before reversing its Shift.';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_collection_operations op
    WHERE NOT op.is_reversed AND (op.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments link
      JOIN public.customer_payments payment ON payment.id = link.customer_payment_id
      WHERE link.operation_id = op.id AND payment.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id))
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_opening_payments link
    JOIN public.supplier_payments payment ON payment.id = link.supplier_payment_id
    WHERE link.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id AND NOT COALESCE(payment.is_reversed, false)
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_cheque_claim_payments link JOIN public.supplier_payments payment ON payment.id=link.supplier_payment_id
    WHERE link.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id AND NOT payment.is_reversed
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_SHIFT_HAS_UNIFIED_OPERATIONS: الوردية تحتوي تحصيلاً موحداً أو سداد رصيد مورد افتتاحي؛ اعكس هذه العمليات أولاً.';
  END IF;

  -- Withdrawals of this shift and returns booked in it: lock, then decide
  -- before any write.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals
  WHERE effective_shift_id = p_shift_id
     OR withdrawal_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id)
  ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;
  v_plan := public.owner_withdrawal_shift_reversal_plan_internal(p_shift_id);
  IF NOT (v_plan->>'canExecute')::BOOLEAN THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = v_plan->>'blockedReason';
  END IF;

  v_result := public._reverse_cash_shift_with_operations_before_phase42_refund_guard(
    p_shift_id, p_reason, p_idempotency_key
  );
  IF COALESCE((v_result->>'idempotent')::BOOLEAN, false) THEN
    -- The first execution already handled withdrawals in its transaction.
    RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_plan);
  END IF;
  v_reversal_id := (v_result->>'reversalId')::UUID;

  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'withdrawalsToReverse') LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals (
      withdrawal_id, effective_shift_id, amount_in_minor_units, reason, reversed_by,
      via_shift_reversal_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint
    ) VALUES (
      (v_item->>'withdrawalId')::UUID, p_shift_id, (v_item->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, v_reason, v_user_id,
      v_reversal_id, 'shift-reversal:' || v_reversal_id::TEXT || ':' || (v_item->>'withdrawalId'),
      md5('shift-reversal|' || v_reversal_id::TEXT || '|' || (v_item->>'withdrawalId'))
    );
    v_reversed_count := v_reversed_count + 1;
    v_reversed_amount := v_reversed_amount + (v_item->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;
  END LOOP;

  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.owner_withdrawal_void', 'on', true);
  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'returnsToVoid') LOOP
    UPDATE public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals
    SET voided_at = clock_timestamp(), voided_by = v_user_id, voided_by_shift_reversal_id = v_reversal_id
    WHERE id = (v_item->>'reversalId')::UUID AND voided_at IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_RETURN_CHANGED: تغيّر عكس سحب أثناء عكس الوردية؛ أعد المحاولة.';
    END IF;
    v_voided_count := v_voided_count + 1;
    v_voided_amount := v_voided_amount + (v_item->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;
  END LOOP;
  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.owner_withdrawal_void', 'off', true);

  IF v_reversed_count + v_voided_count > 0 THEN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
    VALUES (v_user_id, 'REVERSE_OWNER_WITHDRAWALS_FOR_SHIFT', 'cash_shifts', p_shift_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reversal_id', v_reversal_id, 'reason', v_reason,
        'withdrawals_reversed', v_plan->'withdrawalsToReverse', 'returns_voided', v_plan->'returnsToVoid'));
  END IF;

  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', jsonb_build_object(
    'withdrawalsReversedCount', v_reversed_count,
    'withdrawalsReversedInMinorUnits', v_reversed_amount,
    'returnsVoidedCount', v_voided_count,
    'returnsVoidedInMinorUnits', v_voided_amount));
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-461"></a>
## reverse_customer_collection_v1(p_operation_id uuid, p_reason text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_customer_collection_v1(p_operation_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');
  v_operation public.customer_collection_operations%ROWTYPE;
  v_payment_id UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'], 'عكس عملية تحصيل');
  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب سبب العكس (5 إلى 500 حرف).';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_operation FROM public.customer_collection_operations WHERE id = p_operation_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عملية التحصيل غير موجودة.';
  END IF;
  IF v_operation.is_reversed THEN
    RETURN public.go_live_collection_result_internal(v_operation.id) || jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay', true);
  END IF;
  IF v_operation.cash_shift_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id = v_operation.cash_shift_id AND status = 'open' FOR UPDATE) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن عكس سند قبض مرتبط بوردية مغلقة؛ سجّل تسوية تدقيقية جديدة بدلاً من ذلك.';
  END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.collection_reversal', v_operation.id::TEXT, true);
  FOR v_payment_id IN SELECT customer_payment_id FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments
    WHERE operation_id = v_operation.id ORDER BY customer_payment_id
  LOOP
    PERFORM public.reverse_customer_order_payment(v_payment_id,
      'عكس عملية تحصيل ' || v_operation.operation_number || ': ' || v_reason);
  END LOOP;
  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.collection_reversal', '', true);
  UPDATE public.customer_collection_operations
  SET is_reversed = true, reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = v_user_id, reversal_reason = v_reason
  WHERE id = v_operation.id RETURNING * INTO v_operation;
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'CUSTOMER_UNIFIED_COLLECTION_REVERSED', 'customer_collection_operations', v_operation.id,
    jsonb_build_object('operation_number', v_operation.operation_number, 'customer_id', v_operation.customer_id,
      'amount_in_minor_units', v_operation.amount_in_minor_units, 'reason', v_reason));
  RETURN public.go_live_collection_result_internal(v_operation.id) || jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay', false);
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-462"></a>
## reverse_customer_opening_balance_v1(p_entry_id uuid, p_reason text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_customer_opening_balance_v1(p_entry_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');
  v_entry public.customer_opening_balances%ROWTYPE;
  v_allocated BIGINT;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'عكس دين عميل افتتاحي');
  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب سبب العكس (5 إلى 300 حرف).';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_entry FROM public.customer_opening_balances WHERE id = p_entry_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الرصيد الافتتاحي غير موجود.';
  END IF;
  IF v_entry.is_reversed THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', true, 'entryId', v_entry.id,
      'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'reversedAt', v_entry.reversed_at);
  END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.amount_in_minor_units), 0) INTO v_allocated
  FROM public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a
  JOIN public.customer_collection_operations op ON op.id = a.operation_id
  WHERE a.opening_balance_id = p_entry_id AND NOT op.is_reversed;
  IF v_allocated > 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_OPENING_HAS_COLLECTIONS: لا يمكن عكس دين قديم حُصّل منه مبلغ؛ اعكس عملية التحصيل أولاً.';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.customer_opening_balances
  SET is_reversed = true, reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = v_user_id, reversal_reason = v_reason
  WHERE id = p_entry_id RETURNING * INTO v_entry;
  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)
  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_CUSTOMER_OPENING_REVERSED', 'customer_opening_balances', v_entry.id,
    jsonb_build_object('entry_number', v_entry.entry_number, 'customer_id', v_entry.customer_id,
      'amount_in_minor_units', v_entry.amount_in_minor_units,
      'original_debt_date', v_entry.original_debt_date, 'reason', v_reason,
      'after_go_live_finish', (SELECT finished_at IS NOT NULL FROM public.go_live_setup_state WHERE id)));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', false, 'entryId', v_entry.id,
    'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'reversedAt', v_entry.reversed_at);
END;
$function$
```

<a id="function-463"></a>
## reverse_customer_order_payment(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text)

Owner: `postgres`; security: DEFINER; volatility: `v`.
Search path/config: `["search_path=public, pg_temp"]`.
Effective EXECUTE grants: `[{"role":"authenticated","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false},{"role":"postgres","grantor":"postgres","grantable":false}]`.
Raw ACL: `["postgres=X/postgres","authenticated=X/postgres"]`; extension: `none`.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order_id UUID;
  v_shift_id UUID;
  v_locked_order_id UUID;
  v_locked_shift_id UUID;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'عكس سند قبض عميل'
  );
  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id
  INTO v_order_id, v_shift_id
  FROM public.customer_payments payment WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'Customer payment not found.';
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|' || v_order_id::TEXT, 0));
  IF v_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id FOR UPDATE;
  END IF;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order WHERE customer_order.id = v_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id
  INTO v_locked_order_id, v_locked_shift_id
  FROM public.customer_payments payment
  WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_locked_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_id
    OR v_locked_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_shift_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';
  END IF;
  RETURN public._reverse_customer_order_payment_before_phase4_lock(
    p_payment_id, p_reason
  );
END;
$function$
```

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_operational_expense(p_expense_id uuid, p_reason text)

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

  v_shift_id UUID;
  v_locked_shift_id UUID;

  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(
    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],
    'عكس مصروف تشغيلي'
  );

  FROM public.operational_expenses expense WHERE expense.id = p_expense_id;

  FROM public.operational_expenses expense
  WHERE expense.id = p_expense_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_locked_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_shift_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',
      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Expense Shift relationship changed.';
  END IF;
  RETURN public._reverse_operational_expense_before_phase4_lock(
    p_expense_id, p_reason
  );
